text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Kitomenu kya utadi kikibhobha mu menya mukonda dya nguzu ya thandu a menya.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Kixinu kya makutu kibita mukonda jimolekula ja menya kutandu ya menya amwabangesa kuyila kwengi kwa akwa ku jimolekula ja mulenge kutandu dya.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Ojimolekula ja menya jibhanga kikonda kikimoneka bhu thandu a menya jibhangesa tuma twofele kala nguya kukala ku thandu a menya.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Olamina mu jipati jya jelu ya ubhe yakala ni jimbanjilu jiyadi ni dikungu dyabhange mwaxaxe ka ene. Ojimbandu jyene kiyadi jibhana owufwamenu wambote wa kwendela ku thandu dya jelu, nyi kyoso kya hetama.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Kuma kivongo kya lamina kyahengala lwofele, kyoso lamina ihengala ku mbandu imoxi mba ku mbandu yengi, mbandu ya ulungu yazukama ku jelu yahengala we.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Yiyi ibhangesa mukwa malola kudibhala. Eye malola mazendalala ku mbandu ya kadilu, mukwa malola ulunguluka ku mbandu ya kadilu, ya malola mazendalala ku mbandu ya kyasu, mu kwa malola ulunguluka ku kya su.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Phala avutuke mu kitala kya mwene kya Energia, watokala kweha energia yosweke kyoso atambula mukengeji.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Ayibanga mukutundisa mbandu yofele ya mukengeji ixana “fotan”.
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Jingijiye exana mikanda yiyi kwila “widikisu wobhange kwa enelegiya” mukonda jyatomo ajibhangesa utemesu kwala mukengeji wabhenya, ubekesa utumikisu wa kijiminu kya mukengeji, anga mukengeji ukexilu wa utumikisu wa enelejiya.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Kizunzumbya kyakayela ilondekesa ojyatomo atundisa jifoton. Kyene mwene, mu kidi, jifoton atolo kyavulu dingi ya kizunzumbya ndenge.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Tufufutlila twatolu dingi mu tuzongesa ni jisekenene jitenesa jatomo!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Kyoso kyabiti jihama ja jiwola ja kikalakalu, kamudya ka kimwikinu anga izuba kudijima anga okimwikinu ixisa okukalakala.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Lampada yabingi kwibhinganesa. Kyabingi kudilanga mu kubhinganesa kwa lampada.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Kyadyanga, kivunzisu kya kimwikinu kyabingi kukijima mba kukijima.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Kiki kibhita mukonda eletelesidade yiya ku tomada kwoso mbandu ya utadi ya kimwikinu ixala kukanga yasoku kukubhana kilutwilu kya eletelesidade kyadikota he ukwata moxa tomada mba sukilu ya utadi ya kimwikinu kyoso kyene yala hanji ni mukila ku tomada.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Kidyandu kyakatunda kya ukungulukilu wa manyinga phumbulu imwanga manyinga.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Manyinga atunda mu phumbulu mu dibitilu exana lumbungu ni mavutuka mu phumbulu mu kaxi ka ididi exana mixiba. Tulumbungu twofele atwixana tumuxiba twa manyinga.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Mazu ma triceratops kimoxi atena kututula ki mafe ngo, maji jithangu ni jindanji jakolo kyavulu.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Sayi jingijiye jibanza kuma Triceratops akexile mu kudya cicadáceas, ibundu ya mixi yakexile dingi mu kumoneka mu Cretáceo.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Omixi iyi yadifu ni diye dyofele ni kilanda kya mafe azwika ni asongo.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Triceratops kimoxi hinu yabange ni muzumbu we yakala ni nguzu phala kukatula omafe mukudyanga kudya omuxi.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Jingiji jamukwa amba kwila isasa yiyi ifwisa kyavhulu, kyene kibhangesa kwila kyama kakidi, sumbala lelu luzebuku ni ni yama yamukwa kala kaphakayu (abhinganu a lezebuku) atena kudya yangumba mba ibundu ifwisa.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Kyebhi ukondamenu wa Io ungikwata? A ngexile kuthandu ya Io, kiyejinema lwavulu kyoso inema mu Mgongo.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Muthu umoxi unema 200 dya jlibra (90kg) bhu Mavu wendele kunema 36 jilibra (16kg) mu Mbeji. Mu kilunga kyoso, onguzu, ni kidi, yamusungu lwofele.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Dikumbi kidyala ni kikonda kitena kumukwatekesa kala ngongo. Dikumbi dyobhange ni jingaji, tubhya ni pilajima.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: ngaji ikituluka dingi yaleluka kyoso kisanduka bhu kaxi ka Dikumbi.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Obhu kanga dya mbandu itwamumona kyoso kituyala ku Mwanya tuyixana fotosfera, ilomboloka “ndundulu ya tubhya”.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Mu kifika kya tuzunda tutatu twa mivu izamu, mu 1610, ngijiye ya jithembwa ni dyeji ya Italia Galileo Galilei wakalakala ni telescopio phala kumona kwila Vénus yala ni ithangana, kyene kimoxi ni mbeji.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Oyithangana abita mukonda mbandu imoxi ngo ya Vénus (mba ya dyeji) yolungulule ku mwanya yene ayimwikina. Oyithangana ya Vénus axikinisa okizwelu kya Copérnio ya kwila ojipalaneta ajingululaku mwaxaxe ka Lwanya.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Mu usulukilu, kwabhiti mivu, mu muvu wa 1639, ngijiye ya jithethembwa ya Inglaterra amwixana Jeremiah Horrocks wamono mukalakata wa Vénus.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: ixi ya Inglaterra yalayele kibatu kya dikota ni kutululuka kyoso Danelaw watambula lwamukwa ufolu.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Mu yoso, ku 991, Ethelred wabale ndumba ya mawulungu viking yonene dingi tunde Guthrum, mu hama imoxi ya mivu ya dyanga.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Phunga yiyi yakexile mu utuminu wa Olaf Trygvasson, mukwa ixi ya Noruega ni lwimbi lwa kukwata ixi ye yakexile mu kituminu kya ixi ya o Dinmarca.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Kyoso kyabhiti itateku ya masoladi mu dimatekenu, Ethelred watena kuxikina omabha ni Olaf, wavutuka ku ixi ya Noruega mu kayula ka kufikisa kutolola utuminu we ni kutena kwadibundu.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul yene ngo itote yohabike mulwelu phala usonekenu wa mundu wa lelu. Oyitote yohabike mu muvu wa 1444 kyoso Sejong (1418-1450) kyahinga ungana.
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Soba Sejong wakexile soba yakawana ya Dinastia Joseon anga mwene we katunda mu jisoba.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Mwene, mu dimatekenu, watumbula lufabetu mu dijina dya Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum, kilomboloka “jimbimbi jayuka phala ulongesu wa mundu”.
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Kwala ilongesu yavulu yatokala mu ulombolelu wa umonekenu wa sânscrito. Mudya umoxi phala utundilu wa Ariana mu Fwila Kumbi ndu ku Índia yu weza ni dimi dye ni ene.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanscrito dimi dya ukulu, adisokesa ni Latim yozwele ku Europa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Ondunda (divulu) yokulu ya mundu yosonekene mu dizwi dya sanscrito. Kyoso kyabhiti ubhonzeselu wa Upanishade, sanscrito yabhu mukonda dya ungana.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sancristo dizwi dimoxi dyatenena ni dyakala ni kijingu kyoso, kwamutunda odikwatekesu dya mazwi a lelu atokala ku ixi ya India, kala we odizwi dya Latim dibhana o ikwetekesu ku mazwi a jixi ja ngongo ya Europa kala Frances ni Espanhol.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Ku disukilu dya Mvunda ni ixi ya França, oyixi ya Alemanha yamateka okudisokejeka phala kutambula okizanga kya Grã-Bretanha.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Alemanha kaloloka oyita ya “Kisotelu Sealion”. Mawuta mavulu madikota ni ukexilu wa masoladi ma Britania atexikile kyoso mwene amutumikisile ku Dunquerque, kyene kiki o kibhuka kya masoladi kyexile ni nguzu yatolu.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Makwenze a Mwenexi ma Menya ma Kalunga makexile dingi ni nguzu yasoko phala kubhanga ni Makwenze ma menya ma Kalunga ka Alemanha (“Kriegsmarine”) ni endele kubhanga ujibhanganga kwa oso atumikisa Mu mukungulukilu wa Mancha.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Mu yoso, mawulungu matolo ma Marinha Real emanene mu mazukame ma jinjila ja kavanza, mukonda omalumilante akexile ni usudi wakwabobesa ku mawuta atundila bulu ya akwa Alemanha.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Tumateke ni kulombolola yalungu ku ixinde ya Itália. Itália yabetelekota mukala “phange” ya Alemanha ni ya Japão.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Exile ni kibhuka kya masoladi kya kambe nguzu yatena ni makwenze ma menya, nyi kwila azubhile kutunga mawulungu awana awubhe kyoso haji ita kiyandekele lwa.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Owandalelu wabhindamena akwa Italia jixi ja Africa. Phala kukutisa jixi jiji, atokalele kukala ni musanzu wa kididi kya masoladi, phala masoladi natena kwendela mu menya mu kaxi ka kalunga ka Mwditeraneo anga aditakula mu Africa.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Ku kiki, abingile kudikula ku maulungu a ixi ya Inglaterra mu ixi ya Egipto. Katuku hanji oubhangelu yu, omaulungu a ita a ixi ya Italia k’atenene kubhanga dingi nyi kima kimoxi.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Kindala phala Japá. Japá yexile ixi mu menya, kyene we kyala Gra-Bretanha.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Submarinos maulungu ayudika phala kwendela bhoxi dya menya ni kukalamu mu ithangana ya vulu.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Mawulungu a koxi menya abhangelanawu mu mvunda yadyanga ni yakayadi ya mundu. Mu kitangana kiki, akokolokele kyavulu ni akexi ni kibela kya kuloza kyo phopheke kyavulu.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Mu dimatekenu dya ita, enda bhu uvule ku tandu a menya a kalunga, mu kitangana kimateka kitalesu kutala kibhinga o atumini kubhitila moxi a menya phala kamone.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Akwa ixi ya Alemanha endela koxyamenya aexanene U-Boats. Akwa ixi ya Alemanha akexile athu ambote mukutabhula ni kwendesa endela koxi ya menya. Tubamba tutu atwixana tulembyatubhya.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Mukonda wa jimbote je ni mawulungu akoxi a menya, kyabite oyita, kitudyelela akwa Alemanha phala kukala ni yavulu ya ene.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Xe! Sobha Tutancamon, sayi izuwa amutumbula kala “Sobha Tut” mba “Sobha Munzangala”, Sobha imoxi mu jisobha ja Egito jokulu ajijiya mu izuwa ya lelu.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Mu hanji ya kwijiya, mwene kamukitile kuma muthu wakatunda mu ithangana y’okulu ni kamusonekesa we ni dijina mu kixindu kyonnene kyokulu kya enexi.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Mu kiki, usangelu wa mbila ya mwene mu 1922 yamubangesa kukala ni fmua. Jimbila javulu jaxahulu anyana, o mbila iyi ayixi yatenena.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Itumu yavulu yofunde ni Tutankhamun ajibake kyambote, ni ima yakamukwa ajibange ni utadi yakatunda ni matadi kiyidimonekena.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Ubhangelu wa dyanga malola ma itomenu yabhangesa ibatu ya komboio ya akwa Siria kubebuluka, kwenda ni lusolo ni usokeselu wa mbote phala kubhita masoladi ni ibhatu yamukwa.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Madyonga ma mifula makufwa exibokona ku mawuta ma masoladi madizembe. Mu muvu wa 1000 A.C., akwa Assírio ate kibuka kya tubalu kyadyanga.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Eye Kyene kibuka kimoxi kya masoladi azoka ni tubalu. Ombenza ya kaleya ki ayitungunine hanji, mu kiki okibuka kya masoladi ya kabalu assíria wazoko kutandu ya makunda ya utadike ya tubalu twa.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Twejiya athu avulu awanji, jingijiye, ni ikoji ya Grécia. Mu kinyiki omuthu amwijiya dingi wa ifwa ni idifwa iyi mwene Homero, kafofo mukwa jisabhu wala ku muxima, wabange ikalakalu iyadi yadyanga ya musoso wa Grécia: omisoso Ilíadas ni Odisseia.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sofocles ni Aristofanes hanji ala akwa kwolelesa athu anga ikalakalu ya ayitange kwila ikalakalu yakatunda mu malunda a jindunda jangongo.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Mukwa ixi ya Grécia wafumana we mwene ngijiye ya Matematika Pitágoras, wafumana benge-benge mukonda dya teyolema yalungu ni kudibana kwa jimbandu ja jitiliyangulu letu.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Kwakala isokesu ya madifanganu mavulu yatokala ni kithangu kya athu azwela Hindi. Ayisokesa kuma yakala mukaxi ka kayadi ni kawana ya mazwi ayizwela dingi mu ngongo.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Kitangu kya azwedi avwalukila bhu kididi kyenyokyo mu kayula ka kwa ekijiya mba kana mazwi adifu kyavulu.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Oyizongelu yalela mu 340 ndu mu 500 ya jihulakaji ja azweledi, suke 800 ya jihulakaji ja athu asoko kwiva odizwi.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi ni Urdu mazwi adifu mu mabha akuzwela, anga adixisa mu kusoneka; mu kudizwelesa kwa kizuwa ni kizuwa, azwedi a mazwi ene kiyadi mu kilunga kyoso amutena kudiva.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Mu wendelu mu hama dya mivu XV, thunda ya Estónia yakexi ni kitenu kya ifwa ni idifwa ya ixi ya Alemanha.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Sayi jimonje ja Alemanha amesenene kuzukamesa Nzambi ku mundu wa ixi, mukonda dya kyenyiki ayudika dizwi literal estónia.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Akizangula ku Alufabetu ya Alemanha anga abandekesa kitote kimoxi “Õ/õ”.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Ni ubhitulu wa kithangana, mabha avulu asobha ku dizwi dya Alemão adihandamesa. Kiki kyene kyadibhange dimatekenu dya iluminismo.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Tunde ukulu, omulundudi wa ungana wene mwenda ku pholo ya masoladi kyoso kyazubha xikola.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Mu yoso, Charles wayi ku xikola ya kitala kyonene ku Trinity College, Cambridge, kwene Antolopolojiya ni Alukewolojiya, mukusuluka wadilongo Musoso, watolola kimoxi 2:2 (kitala kimoxi kya phunga ya kayadi yofele).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles mwene mutumini wadyanga kudilonga mu xikola ya katunda ku mwiji wa Usoba wa Britanya.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turquia ya Europa( Tracia Orientel mba Rumelia mu peninsula ya Balcas) ubhandekesa 3% ya ixi.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: OyIxi ya Turquia yala dingi ni 1.600 km (1,000 mi) ya ulebhelu ni 800 km (500 mi) ya unzanzelu, ni ukexilu wambandu jiwana jasokelela mu jiyadi jiyadi, ( yexana mu phutu retangulo).
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Musanzu wa Turquia, wolungusi ni lagos, utenesa 783.562 ya ilometulu mu luwana (300.948 sq mi), ku yene 755.688 ya ilometulu mu luwana (291.773 sq mi) yala ku lwiji dyaAsia ni 23.764 ya ilometelu mu luwana (9.174 sq mi) ku Europa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Omusanzu wa Turquia imubangesa 37º kukala ixi yonene ya ngongo, anga yazukama ku ukomenu wa ixi ya França Metropolitana ni ya Reino Unido kumoxi.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turquia yojinguluke ku tulunga ku jimbandu jitatu: Mar Egeu ku fwila kumbi, Mar Negro ku thunda ni Mar Mrditerraneo ku lwiji.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Mbanza ya Luxemburgo yakala ni musoso wadikota, anga diphanda dye aditambula mu muvu wa 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Ididi ya lelu ya Belgika yakexile ku mbandu ya Luxemburgu no ukulu, maji phe yalunguluka ya Belgica kyoso kyabhitile Levulusa ya Belgica ya 1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxemburgo wabhangela kukala ixi kiyaxamanena kuma, maji phe aate ku ubika mu ita yadyanga ni ya kayela ya ngongo kwala Alemanha.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Mu muvu wa 1957, Luxemburgo wakituka kidyandu kyandeka ni usokeselu yu lelu akijidila kuma Kisangela kya Europa.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: O Drukgyal Dzong Mbonge ya masoladi nhundu kya kuthunda ngeleja ya Buda mu mbandu yonene mu kibatu kya Paro (mu Dyembu dya Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Akitange kuma 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel wabhange Mbonge phala kukemba ulungilu we ku kizoku ni masoladi akwa Tibete ku Mongol.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Mu 1951, kujokotelu kwa ima yokulu ya Drukgyal Dzong kwanane, kala o kidifwa kya a Zhabdrung Ngwang Nangyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Kyoso tubhya twajimi, osabalalu ayikondelela ni ayilange, yala hanji kmua kyene kididi kya dikota kyawabha mu Butá.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Mwaxaxe ka hama dya mivu mu XVIII, Camboja amubwetele kwala azukami me ayadi akwa kutena, Tailândia ni Vietname.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Akwa ixi ya Tailandia abhokona ni nguzu ya mawuta mu mbanza ya Cambonja izuwa yavulu mu hama dya mivu tunde XVIII ni mu 1772 abhulu Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Mu mivu yasukuku ya XVIII dya hama dya mivu, akwa Vietname atambula we mbanza ya Camboja.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Dikwinyi ni dinake dya akwa Venezuela kyamukalakala, ombandu yavulu ya akalakadi amukalakala ku umoni wa kitanda.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Mbandu jiyadi mu lutatu ja akwa Venezuela akalakala akibhanga mu ididi yatokalela kukalakala, kisoka umoxi mu luwana akalakala mu ditenda anga umoxi mu kitanu mu mabhya.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Sayi ditenda dyakatunda dya phiti mwaxaxe ka mundu wa ixi ya Venezuela, kwene ixi isumbisa phiti ku jixi ja makanga, nyi kuma mu hama mwakala ngo mbandu imoxi dya athu amukalakala mu ditenda.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Mu dimatekenu dya ufolo wa ixi, ungijiye wa Kididi kya Itulu kya Singapura akwatesa kubilula dizanga ku Mbanza ya Itulu yatema.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Mu muvu wa 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, olokidya imoxi yabwingita, ayisolu phala ikale okithulu kya ixi.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Mu mivu yoso, kyoso kibhixila ombeji ya Kamusasadi 1,5 kya kazunda ka yama idya ngo oyangu yenda njila ya kikangalakata kya lwiji, mu kuzawuka ongiji Mara, tunde mu tumilundu twa mbandu ya thunda ku jimvula.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Muvutka kusuku mutunda kulwiji, muzawuka ohonga ya Mara, kyoso kyabhu mvula bhu Katanu.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Kididi kya Serengeti kyakala ni Kitonokenu kya Serengeti, Kididi kya Kubhakela ya Ngorongoro ni Kididi kya Unyanaga kya Maswa mu ixi ya Tanzânia ni Ditonokenu dya Maasai Mara ku Quénia.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Kudilonga kubhanga “mediya intelativa” kwabingi wijidilu wa masunga a ngongo yoso, kala we iselekete mu mawulongesu ma kuditambwisa amuta m'ulongelu wa intelativa (misoso mu twifika twa jimbandu jiwana, usokejeku wa mazwi ni izuzumbya, utelu wa misoso ni imbamba ya mukwa we dingi)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Kwijiya kudibhana ni akwenu, kubhanga kwila uzonga kizwelu kye kuthandu dya jihundu anga kiwubanze mu ubeka.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Okudilunga mukudiva kijijidika kuma yo alaku akwa kixinde kimoxi adilunga mudya, maji we kubanga kikexilu kala ungana umoxi yowangunune.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Udibotelu wa mawana zoom kyene kivudisu mu njila ni itangu ya majina a idyandu ya mawana yatokala phala kusanga mikawu yitwandala, ivula dingi, mawana prime ndenge.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Kiki kyala mu bhiluka mu ukexilu wambote mukonda akwa kwidika itetu ya mawana abhixila mu itala yamakota ya kwidika mawana.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Kiki kyakwatekesa mawana zoom mu kubhanga izuzumbya ya kuwabha kwasokelesa ni yakatula kwala mawana ni dikanga kutwinisa kwemana.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Ukexilu wamukwa kiwambote wa mawana zoom jene muweza (ulengelu) wa mawana wene mukala ndenge.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Kiki kibangesa omawama zoom kukala ni swilu yatolo yabonzo kuyizwata kyoso mukengeji watolo anga yakambe flash.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Maka amumonekaku dingi kyoso kyamufikisa kubhilula filime imoxi mu ukexilu wa DVD kwene kuvula kwa izuzumbya.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Kivule kya italeselakanga ajibhanga phala kuwabesa omundu mu yoso.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Kinyiki, yoso imona mu kitalesela kanga jimbambe ajibatula, bulu, koxi ni mu jimbandu.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: kiki akibange phala kukwatekesa kuma okizuzumbya kifuta lumwenu lwoso. ku iyi ayixana overscan.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Ni kuluwala kwoso, kyoso kya bhanga DVD imoxi, nangene ibumu ye ebatu, se ilaye-laye ya filime yakala ni isoneku yazukama kyavhulu ku mbandu ya bhoxi, kanda tena kwilondekesa ni unzunda.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Sabalalu ya soba yokulu tunde ukulu ikubangesa kubanza, kuximana izoku, izomba ni ukexilu wambote wa Artur.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Nyi mu kwimana mukaxi ka jingundo já hama dya mivu, kikibhonzo kujabuluka jimbimbi ni dizumba dya ita dyamwanganene mu ukulu, kifwa kwiva jibuya já itetu ya ngalafa mu jinjila ni kwiva dizumba dya woma wa kubhanda mu makungu.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Okwila owubanzelu wetu kwalungu ni kidi? Mukonda dyahi kyatungu jisabalalu mu kubuta kyadyanga? Kyebhi kyajibanze ni kyajitungu?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Kyatokala ku kithangana, Sabalalu Kirby Muxloe inzo imoxi dingi yakondamesa mu sabalalu ya kidi.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Jimbangula je jonene jabange ni vidulu ni jimbalu jatolo hinu katena kukala ni nguzu ku kavanza kamoxi mu ithangana yavulu.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Mu dikwinyi dya mivu tunde 1480, kyoso kyamateka utungilu we wamateka kwala Lord Hastings, ixi yakexile mu kutululuka ni kyabingile ngo uzokelu umoxi ku jimbandu jofene ja miyi endele mu ididi.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Owusokeselu wa wanji wakexile ubhangelu umoxi mwakexile mu kusota okusuluka ni utuminu wa jixi jyoso jya ngongo ya Europa.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Oyibanzelu yakexilu mu kwila ojixi jyoso jya ngongo ya Europa jyendele kusota okuvunza oyixi imoxi mu kukituluka kitanji kitumina yoso, kiki o jinguvulu jya jixi jyendele kubhinganesa lwavulu omakamba mu kayula ka kusokolokesa owukexilu wafwama.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Ita ya ubhinganu mu ixi ya Espanha yaxine dyandekelu dya ita yadyanga, maka abekela ita usokeselu wa utuminu.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Kiki kyaxinde ulungulwilu wakatunda, mu kwila xixi jala ni nguzu yonene mu ibhatu ya Europa yakaxisa kukala ni kifwamanesu kwila ita ya jingeleja. Mu kiki, Ita ya Makwinyi atatu a mivu yeji kala yene yasukuku mu ixinda kwila ita ya jingeleja.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: okithangana kya Artemis ku Efesu ayizabge mu kizuwa kya 21 ya mbeji ya Kavwa ya muvu wa 356 a.C. mu kaxi ka tubhya kwa kutakula kwala Herostratus.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Kyalungu ni musoso, hanji ye yakexile mu kusanga fuma ku yoso. Akwa Efésios, ni jinjinda, abhana ongolokela ya kwila seku kithangana kyendele kubhana dibhengu dya kusoneka dijina dya Herostratus.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Mukwa sabhu Grego Strabo ku pholo ya kuya wasange dijina, kala kitwadijiya lelu. Ngeleja yobule mu usuku wenyo wavwala Alexandre o Grande.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexandre, mukulundu, wadifelesela kufuta utungilu wa ngeleja, maji aditunu kilumbwisu kye. Kupholo jakuya, kyoso kyafu Alexandre, ngeleja yotunge mu jihama ja mivu ya 323 a. C.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Ukijiya kuma lukwaku lwe lwala kyambote kyoso hanji wala musoneka kyambote- kana we kuzambesa kyavulu omilembu.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Ni ndunge iyi, wandadibwidisa ngo bofele. Jabuluka kuma kiwatokala kubeta jitekla ni nguzu yoso phala kuweza muxindu, kala ku piyanu.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Ku akolediyawum, phala kukala ni kusubu kyavulu, ukwata fole ni nguzu yoso mba ni lusolo.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: O kixikanu ku jinzambi utakanenu wa kukala kumoxi, ukexilu mba ubanzelu wa kidi kya suku, ungana, kidi kya nzumbi mba Nzambi.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Muxikini usota kwijiya kwa kidi, kibanzelu, mba wividilu wa kidi wa nzambi/wa unzambi mba ufwilu.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Akwa kukayela asota ifwa yakukala mba ibangelu ya mwenyu yakala ni kixinde kyakukuna mawijidilu ya.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Okuxikana jinzambi jamakutu atena kuyitungula mu ifwa yengi yakuxikana ni kusambela mu ngeleja mu utumbikilu we mu wijidilu wa muthu mu ukalelu wa kilunji kimoxi, bengebenge mu kifwa kya heda, mutonginina, wazediwa mba wemana.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Siquismo kididi kimoxi kyatokala ku mbandu ixi ya Índia. Kyamatekena bhu kididi kya Punjab mwaxaxe ka hama ya mivu ya XV, mukonda dya uwanenu ni kumoneka kwa twibhuka mwaxaxe ka ifwa ni idifwa ya Hindu.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Sikhs amono kixikanu kya ene kuma ngeleja yadiwanguna k’uxikanu wa o Hindu, nyi kuma ejiya we jindenji ja ene, ifwa ni idifwa ya jihindu.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Sikhs ngeleja ya ayixana Gurmat, yene Punjabi phala “njila ya guru”. Guru ukexilu wabeta mu jingeleja joso jaji Indiana, maji ku Sikhismo watambula ukinji wadibhange dikaxi dya kuxikana Sikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Kixikanu kwa Nzambi akixinganeka mu Sec.XV kwala Guru Nanak (1469-1539) Jadikayela divwa dya jiguru jamukwa.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Mu kilunga kyoso, mu mbeji ya Kasambwadi mu muvu wa 1956, ongudi ya Krushchev ebhange kavwanza kyoso kyabhange owusulukutu wa kutakula oyibujinganga mu ixi ya Polonia, kwamonekene akalakadi akexile mu kudikalanganza nu konda dya ukambu wa makudya ni ubatwilu wa futu, wakituluka usulukutu wakatunda mu kudituna okomunismo.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Nyi kuma ku disukilu, Krushchev watumikisa makalu a ita phala kukwatesa owoma, waxila ohanji imoxi ya umoni ni waxikina okusola kafumana Wladyslaw Gomulka kuma kisengele-kyadyanga.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Ukexilu wa axahulu a Vale ya Indo yexile ukexilu wa kitala kya Bolonze ku lwiji dya musanzu wa thunda ni kufwila kumbi ya Índia, suke ku jimbandu javulu ja Paquistão ni ibhatu yamukwa ku thunda ni kufwila kumbi ka Índia ni kutundila kuntundila kumbi ya Afeganistão.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Owijidilu wa ukulu wakulu mu mikungilukilu wa ngiji Indo, kwene kwatundu odijina dye.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Nyi kuma maxibhulu avulu amuta umbwembwe kuma, atokala akixikina kuma ukexilu wambote wexile kya tunde ukulu mu izanga lelu exana ngiji yakukuta Soravasti, yeji kala, mu kidi, kuyixana Ukexilu wa Indus;Sarasvati, maji phe akwa ala mu kixana kuka Ukexilu wa Harappan mukonda dya Harappa, mukonda kyene okididi kya adyanga kukanda mu mivu ya 20.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Okifwa kyakukala kya usoladi wambonge wa romano wabandekesa phala okukula kwa asaki.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Imbanda amateka kwa exana kwala Mwenexi Augusto ni asokejeka Phunga Yadyanga ya Imbanda ya ixi ya Roma phala kukalakala mu kayula ka kusaka makwenze mu ita.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Jisiluja ejidile milongu yavulu, kala molofina ya wasu wa ibhundu ya mixi ya papoyila ni xikopolamina ya ibhundu helebanu.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Eye ukalakala ni utoku mu ubhatwilu phala kubhulula haxi ya fidila, kala ijikilu ni jifinete ja mixi phala kujika ubhubhilu wa manyinga.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Ku ubitilu wa hama ni hama dya mivu, utuminu wa Roma wambata mu jingasu javulu mu kidyandu kya kusaka yuwalongesa mbandu yadikota ya wijidilu itwejiya lelu.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Pureland origami mwene origami ni katombo kabunjika lumoxi atena kwibhanga lumoxi lumoxi, kayebhela ibunji ibhiluluka yaludika dingi, ni ibunji yoso yakala ni ididi yahatu.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Etu Ayikudisa kwala John Smith mu muvu wa 1970 phala kukwatekesa yo kyejiya mba kyakala ni utenenu wakudizambesa.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Anandege akula ni kifwa kya ukexilu wa kibha ni kifwa kya katungu ka miji mu unzangala anga katunga kaka kakwata mu kilunji.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Kala kifika, anandenge yo adibhana ni mbandu yofele ya kifwa kya kikonda kyasosolola kyakambe kulondekesa umvwama wa mbote mu xikola ene mu kukamba we kulondekesa umvwama wa mbote mu xikola, kuma amudilonga yoso yalungu ni ima yabolo yene mu kuzwela bhu ka kifwa kya kikonda kyakalanakyu.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: O MySpace kyene kididi mundu woso ejiya ku Estados Unidos, mu lelu yala ni 54 jihulakaji ja jiperfil.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Ididi yiyi yene mu tambula ulangidilu wa dikota, benge-benge mu ididi ya kulonga.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Kwala jimbandu jambote jawebsites, jitena mulusolu kuyukisa mukanda umoxi wa xikola mba blogs, jividyu, jifotu ni ikalakalu yamukwa.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Kibhatu kiki kyasoku kukijikula ni lusolu kyoso ukibhana ngo njila ya web, ikubhangesa kujabuluka ni kusoneka ni lusulu lwoso phala maxibhula, ene mukala ni maka phala kukalakala ni tekiladu mba ni kusoneka kyambote.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Mwene utena kuyikitulula ye mwene ngo mukwilelukisa kuyitanga anga we ni yoso mba ni kifwa kyatolo kala kyamesena.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Owindwa wa Ukambu wa Kwiva “wene owukexilu wa uhaxi utuwama owongo kuma wakala ni itongininu itatu ya kudiva kala nguzu izambesa omukutu, ulandukilu ni uvudilu wa nguzu”.
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Ko unemaku wa uilongesu, itateku ya ulongesu; “utuwama mu 3 ndu 5 dya mbandu ya hama ya anandenge oso, nangene ndu mu 2 tuzunda twa twana twa ixi ya America”.
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Anajindenge ni ADD atate mukudisanga muyima kala mu ikalakalu ya xikola, maji adisanga muyima yawabhela kubhanga kala kuta yela mba kuyala idifwa yote mwenyu favolito mba kusoneka yambe kiyala ni unyohenu.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Anandenge andadita mu maka, mukonda “adita mu maka a ilwezu, adibuba, katumaka atumini” phala kukalakalesa owongo we, mukonda owongo we kyatena kuyikalakalesa mu matelu abeleketa.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: A ADD wadilungu mu udibhelu ni ibuka yamukwa mukonda anandenge amukwa kikyalombolokela mukonda abhanaga kala kya mubhagamba mukonda dya utangelu mu ukexilu wakunga mba mukonda atanga kala kyamubhanga mba ukexilu wawukudilu wengi.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Kmua o kutena kwa kwijiya ni kudilonga kwabhiluluka m’ukexilu, kala kyakitange kya bhulu, o kitangu kya dimatekenu dya kutambula okwijiya kyabhiluluka.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Kudisanga phala kutambula jihundu kwabiti kyengi. Kixinu kikyakexile dingi mu ujabuluku wa ubeka, maji owutenenu kya kujabuluka okisoneku kyadibange dingi kima kya katunda.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Mu kumateka, Renascimento wa bhange ubhilulukisu yakatunda mu kutala kwa kudilonga ni kusambukisa kwa kwijiya.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Kima kyenge ku mbandu ya jixahulu jokulu, jihomenidiu phala kwenda kijexile dingi mukwata bhoxi phala kwenda mba kwambata inemenu mba kunyehena mu kaxi ka mixi.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Lukwaku ni dikanda dya Phombo yadifu mu kukoma ni mu elebelu, mukulondekesa owutelu wa lukwaku phala kutena kwambata inemenu mu njila mu jingonde.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Lukwaku lwa muthu lwabutu dingi mukuyilusokesa ni kinama, ni ifuba ya milembu yalukuma dingi.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Um ifwa yamukwa, adisoneka ngo athu yana axala bhukanga dya jinzo ja akwa kuzunga.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Sayi bhabha athu akala ni kixikanu kya kwila kufikisa kwa jinzoji javulu jatonginina kyambote mu kubhangesa mu lwelu lwavulu kukituka itohwesa.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Kikuma kyakatunda ku maka ya kayula ka nzoji isanzumuna kithangana bhu kaxi ka jixi REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Ni REMs jatolo mu usuku umoxi, ukexilu yu utwala mu fikisa kukwata ku kilu kyonene phala kusokesa mukutu wadibhange kala kiwayizuwa yoso phala ukale maka.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Kiki ibwidisa kyavulu kala ubalumukinu mu makwinyi ayadi mba atatu ya ithangana ni kuyala kitalesela kanga.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Owukexilu wakala mu lukuxi owongo ufikisa onzoji m’ukexilu wa mbote mwaxaxe ka usuku.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Ima kiyala mu kwenda kyambote kwa akwa Italia ku thunda dya Africa ngafika tunde mu ukulu. Mu kaxi ka sona imoxi mukanda wa kixikanesu kya ita ya Italia um kizuwa kya 10 ya Mbeji ya Kanake ya muvu wa 1940, oji 11 jajihusardu ja ixi ya Britania tambwile Forte Capuzzo ku Libia.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Mu kikondelu kimoxi ku mbandu ya kakyasu ya kididi kya Bardia, akwa Grã-Bretânia akutu o Enjinyelu-Mutwameni wa Kifuxi kya Masoladi a Kakwinhi ya Itália, Makulundu Lastucci.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Mu kizuwa kya 28 mu mbe ya kanake, Marechal Italo Balbo, Nguvulu ya ixi yoso ya Libia wabanze kabhinganu ka Mussolini, amujibha kutubhya twa ukamba kyoso kyakexi mu tuluka mu Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Mujoko wa ubhe wa jigilima akutela mu itala, tunde k’ulongelu wa maxibhulu mu xikola yakatunda ndu ku kizokola kya jihete ni kya Olímpica.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Omalunda ene mwibanga mu kikexilu kyakubala, esgrimista kimoxi mukubala mukwa.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Golfe utonokenu umoxi wa akwa kuta mujoko mwakwata muxi phala kutakula jindundulu mu makungu.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Kwinyi ni nake dya dikungu aditakula mu ithangana yakuyala, atakwidi amatekena mudikungu dyadyanga dya kyela nasukila mudikungu dya kwinyi ni nake.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Ulunga mukwa kizoko yo watambula itangu yatolo ya jimbenda, mba ibetelu ya kibhuka, phala kutenesa njila.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Amoxi owukexilu wa ungenji ejidila ukakala yuna mundu wavulu alunga ni wendelu: Ungenji wa kutonoka.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Kiki kyene kyoso athu enda ku kididi kimoxi kyadiwanguna kyavulu ku ukexilu we wa kizuwa ni kizuwa kyatumu phala kunyoha ni kutonoka.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: ku zinzenza ja kalunga, bhu ididi ya isongwelu ni ididi ya unyohenu yene ididi yabeta ikala anyungi ni anyohi.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Kima kyabhekesa ukundilu wa kibuta kyatokala ku kwijiya musoso we ni ifwa ni idifwa, anga ukexilu wa uzungilu yu awijiya kuma uzungilu wa kwijiya ifwa ni idifwa.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Azungi atena kukunda ididi yakatunda yadiwanguna maxaxe ka ixi imoxi mba atena ngo kusangula kidyandu kimoxi.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Jikolono, mukumona ikalakalu yiyi, exanene we kikwatekesu.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Masoladi ahandamesa ukexilu wasuluka abundile 1º ni 3º kya jiphunga ja New Hampshire ja 200 dya mayala, ku utuminu wa Jikolonele John Stark ni James Reed (ene kiyadi ku ubhtilu wa mivu abhiluka jijenelale).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Omayala a Stark atambula oyibuta ku manjilu ya mbambe ya mbandu ya thunda dya ididi mwakexile Kolono.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Kyoso o disubhakelu dya kalunga dyahetama kwajikuka dikungu ku mukungulukilu wa ngiji ya Malunda ku mandu ya thunda dya kizanga kikwatenena ni kibumu, ni lusolo ate ombambe ni kamulundu ka matadi ku mandu ya thunda, mu kisukila bhu mbanjilu ya kibumu ky’ofele.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Ophangu ya America yabingile owutakwilu wa mvunda yendesa tunde mu jinjila jitatu jadiwangununa.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Mukulundu wa masoladi John Cadwalder walumba kudikwata mu kulanduka itaya kwa Britanica mu Bordentown, mukonda dya kuxita nguzu yosoyoso.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: General James Ewing weji kwa mbata 700 athu ni mata mu njila ya menya ku Trenton Ferry, weji tambula o mulonde wa matuka ngiji ya Assumpink Creek ni weji fudisa disoladi dyosodyso dya ingulungumba kulenga.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Nguzu yakatunda ya kunyana 2.400 a mayala yeji zawuka ngiji mu divwa dya jimidya ku thunda dya Trenton, mu kusuluka ikadiwana mu ibhuka iyadi, kimoxi kikala mu kituminu kya Greene okyamukwa Sullivan, phala kutakula ita mu makolombole.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Ni ubhilulukilu wa dixilu dimoxi phala o mbandu ya milya ya ulengelu, o lusolo lwadibhange ndenge ni nguzu yadibhange kiibindamu kya kinene-nene.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Kidi kuma mbandu ya hulakaji ya kitala kyadyanga, diyala ditena kutolola mu ithangana iyadi, utena kukala ni ulengelu lwasoko, maji onguzu yatokala kuyikuna mu ilwezu yoso.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Ulengelu wamukwa kala kibhatulu kya muxitu mu kixibhu, adilungu ni ikalakalu ya nzo mwalongela ana jindenge mbe athu noso phala o mbanji ya tulu ya mukutu, yene yabheta kota mu kwiyuka phala kitangana kya kulenga.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Ibhangesu ya makudya matokala mu kingo kiyitena kuvaluka ukexilu wa sunga, maji phe yasoku kukwatekesa mu mbote ya enyoso ya minzangala ene muta izoku.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Kukala ni ufikidilumwa nguzu mu udisanzelu, kubhanga ifwa ya kunwa menya mu ithangana yatokala ni kuthethuluka mu mawukexilumakudilanga ni kunwa milongu yasoku kukwatekesa akwa malunda phala kuweza nguzu mu uzokelu ni uzolelu ku ikalakalu ya malunda.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Ulengelu wa dikanga dya kaxi dyene dilunda dyate kitadi kyofele; mukiki kwala iselekete itena mukonda yatolo, mu yoso, kwakala makutu mavulu madilungu ni iselekete yatolo yatokala phala kulenga.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Ima yoso asoko kuyismuba kabasa twayandala, maji phe yavulu kitwanda imesena mukonda dya ukexilu .
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Akwa malunda atena kwiva kuma amesena kima kimoxi ha mwene kima kiki kiyibana jimbote jakidi.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Atomo atena okwimona kuma ndobi imoxi yakatunda ya utungilu wa ima yoso.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Muthu wadimuka kyavulu watokala, kala kifika kyalelukisa kya Bohr, mu wongo bhu kaxi ka wendelu wa jiletelonji, kima kyadifu ni jingongo jendela Dikumbi – kuyala ku Kifika 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Okaxaxe kakala ni jimbandu jiyadi - jinewutolonji ni jipolotonji.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Ojipholotonji jakala nguzu ya mukengeji yasoko, ku mbandu ya mukwa, ojinewutolonji jakambe onguzu. Ojiletelonji jakala ni nguzu ya mukengeji y’ofele.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Phala kutalesa mukwa-dilamba, watokala ulonda hanji okididi phala kufikidila okikondejeku.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Kyabhingi kutonginina kikexilu kya yo amutatela mu kithangana kya kumuzukama ni idimbu yoso-yoso ya kipheletendwa kidijila.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: He wadikwama mukwandala kukwatekesa, wakakala ngo phala kuweza maka.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Ulongesu wasukisa kwila kixinu, woma ni wividilu wa kizanguelu kya dikota akwatekesa kudilunga mu kaxi ka mususu ni ukambelu wakutena mu athu akata ndolo ya dikunda.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Mukonda ngo dya ubhangelu wa ubhudikilu, kikibhana kibhanzelu mba woma, ayifudisa phala kuxa kididi ku ikalakalu mu jisona joxinde ja PA josokese.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Akwa kubhanga ikalakalu muyitangana yoxinde akjnga dingi kikwatesu mu mbandu ya kwijiya kyayibha ndolo, mukutena kuzonga idixa ya misusu yavulu ni ukexilu wa kutandanganya mu wendelu wa izuwa.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Owuyalelu mba owukexilu wa kuyala wabingi oyidyandu ya kuyala mba o mesu.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Kwakala utungilu wa vulu wa mesu adiwanguna, abhiluluka k’ukexilu bhu kaxi wa mukutu ni mukutu.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Oyidixa mu utungilu yala we ni idixa mu kutena, ibelesela mu ulebelu wa mafuta, yala ni idixa mu jigrau ja usunga, anga ibhinga ikalakalu yadixi phala kubhana nguzu ku dibokwenu ni itangu kiyadifu phala kukalakala kyambote.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Mundu ulomboloka ubundilu wa idyandu yatokala ku ifwa ni idifwa imoxi mwaxaxe ka kididi kimoxi kya kwijiya kwa ngongo.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Kyoso athu atokala ku mundu umoxi wadifu kyatokala ku ukexilu wadiwanguna, afumana kuma akwa ukexilu imoxi.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Kyoso athu alondekesa idifwa yadixisa kyavulu mu ukexilu umoxi akixana jipolimolifiku.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Ibhuka ya masoladi ya makungu ma jinzéu ni jene jenda we ni abanga ikalanga mu ítala imoxi.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Mu ithangana ya ukambu wa ididi ya kutunga omabata, ojixixikinya jenda njila ya usuku ni emana phala kuzeka mwaxaxe ka kizuwa.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Phunga imateka kithangana kimoxi kya kuzunga kyoso kudya kwakalanayu kwasosoloka. Mu kithangana kiki, kibuka kibanga kikalanga ene muyilungulula izuwa yoso.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: kitundilu ni kitundilu mba wendelu wa kuzungajana ene muyitenesa muyibhatu ya 17 dya izwa.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Eye Selula ihi? Dyambu dya selula dyatundila ku dyambu dya Latim “cella”, dyalombolola “dixilu dyofele”, wadyanga kudisoneka mukwa micoloscopyo kyoso kyazongola kibalabala kya kolotisa.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Selula kyene kidyandu kya dyanga ku ima yoso yakala ni mwenyu, mikutu yoso yakala ni imoxi mba kitangu dingi kya jiselula.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Jiselula jabebuluka kyavulu ni jabonza phala ukexilu wa mwenyu, mu kidi, jene mu kanu dya mundu kala “jindobe jawubumbilu wa mwenyu”.
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Mixibha ikala ni ubatwilu wa manyinga, mu kutumikisa nguzu mukonda dya mukutu phala kusuluisa wendelu wa manyinga, ni kuvunza we itateku.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Onguzu yiyi ya mixibha atena o kwitumikisa ni lusolo mu mukutu woso mu kukwatekesa okubhulula mukutu ku kikanenu kyoso-kyoso.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Itembwe yamakota ituwama kididi kyofele mukudisokesa ni kimvula kyamukwa kya nguzu, maji atena kuzanga yoso mu njila ye.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Yovutukile aibuza mixi, asunga mabaya ma jisabhalalu, ni alumba makalu ku dyulu. Opulucento jiyadi jabeta nguzu jabiluka jinakina dingi dya itangana itatu.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Itembu yamakota iyi yala ni mulenge wa suke 480 Km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Jihulakaji ni jihulakaji já mivu yabiti athu ene mukwidika ni muzwata mawana a kuweza ima.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Jitelexikopyu jiji jatele ibakanu iyadi ya mawana phala kubhangesa kumoneka kwa imbamba yakala dingi dikanga anga jazukama dingi kala jamakota.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Nangene sayi we kizuwa, alulu a eye anda kala ku thandu dya ngongo imoxi mu kutumina akwa jixi jengi mu kubanza ku axakulu mawu?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, ngijiye ya Biologia ya Inglaterra, wamono tundobi twa kolotisa ni mikoloskopyo imoxi.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.
