text: Idyandu ni ilungisu yasoku kudilungulula mu ukexilu wenge maji phe kidyandu kyene kimoxi.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Azoto kala munza wakala hanji kifwa kyene kimoxi kya azoto yabundu ni menya. Ukexilu wadifwangana mwnya watenena dindi, anga jimolekula jene jene we jimoxi.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Menya kifika kya mukwa. Menya akala ni jyatomo jiyadi ja hidolojenyu ni atomo imoxi ya oxijenyu.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Yakala ni ukexilulu wa ngaji, menya ni yadikwata.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Katuku owubhilulukilu wa mukutu, owukexilu we wene hanji umoxi.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Kithangana kima kyakala kwaxaxe kwetu mukutuwama yoso itubhanga, anga kibhindamu kyakala mu kukitongolola.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Okithangana yene ene mudilonga kwala madilongi ajingeleja, jifilozofiku ni jingijiye mu jihulakaji ja mivu.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Twakala mu ithangana ya ndumba ni ndumba dya maka ahadya amubhita mukonda dya kithangana kya lelu phala kuvutuka mukulu.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Kumbi we owanji utwene nawu wa kuzonga ulayelu wa ima.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Xinda eye mwene ubhitilu wa kithangana mu utalelu wa kubangulula kwa kisulukutu kya kizuwa ni kizuwa. Okisulukutu kya kizuwa ni kizuwa kima kibhita mu ukexilu wa kubangulula mu izuwa yoso.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Jikomputadolo ja lelu jala mu kwatekesa phala kulondekesa izuzumbya ni jividiu.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Isangulukisu yakatunda atena kwibhanga mu jikomputadole, ifwa ya isangulukisu yiyi amwilondekesa dingi mu taleselakangai ni mu jifilime ye.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Mu izuwa yavulu mimbu ena muyibaka ni kikwatekesu kya jikomphutadolo jasunga phala kukalakala ni kulungisa mimbu.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Mu kaxi ka ithangana yokulu, muyitangana ya hama XIX ni XX, akitayele kuma axahulu a Nova Zelandia exile mundu wa Maori, exile mu unyanga wa kukwata jinjila jonene ajixana jimoa.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Mu uzwelelu akijiya kuma omwiji wa Maori watundila ku Polinésia mu mukalakata wadikota wa makalu anga atambula Nova Zelandia ya Mariori, abangesa kisangela kya idimakaji.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Mu kuzuba, mawumbange makindala mambe kwila akwa Moriori exile kibhuka kimoxi kya jimaori mu musanzu ya atundu mu Nova Zelandia phala kuya tuzanga twa Chatham, abange ifwa ni idifwa ya yatululuka yakambe kudifwa ni ifwa yengi.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Kwakexile we kibuka kyamukwa mu ilhas Chatham, ya akexile Maoris ayi dikanga kwa Nova Zelandia.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Majina ma Moriori. Kwabhiti itatesu ya mvunda anga mu kusuka, akwa Moriori aajibha
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Athu adikwatele mwaxaxe ka makwinyi ni makwinyi dya mivu yavulu atukwatekesa mu kutalesa yoso yabetakota ni ipheteka yetu mu kithangana kyene kimoxi kyakexile mu kuzambula ni kidi kyoso yoso yalungu ni itateku ni kubela kwa we.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Kyoso kitwiva athu mu kuzwela kyalungu ni misoso ya ubheka, miji ni isangela, tutena kusanga uyalelu wakatunda w’okulu ni athu amoxi abhekesa mbote mba tote ku ifwa ni idifwa ya kisangela.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Nyi kuma kutetuluka kwa musoso kokulomboloka utetulukilu wa ifwa ni idifwa, mwene ukwatekesa athu mu kukala ni kwijiya kwa kwebhi ene abokona mu musoso wa kisangela.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Mu kutalesa kwa yosos yatolola ni kuxingeneka mijoko yabele, athu kibhuka kya athu abhange mbandu ku mijoko atonginina dingi kyate, kinemenu ni nguzu ya kibhuki.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Mu kiki, twituka oyifika yabhiti kya ya ukexilu wa matenda ni fuma ya utolwelu wakwatekesa athu mu kudijikula k’ubhilulukilu wa ubhe ni jinjila ja ubhe kwa jingeleja ja ixi.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Jisabhu jafuma jiji jasosolola woma wa ulungulukilu, mu uvalukisu mu kithangana ni mbandu ubetamenu wadikota phala owulungukilu mu hadya.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Oyilondekesu ya ubanzelu kumoxi yene yala ni undungi wakusokesa maka alungisa maba oso-oso mba musanzu phala kusanga dibatwilu dya maka.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Okyabetakota ku ubanzelu yu olusolo, okidi ni utoku, utongininu we wa isulukutu, utelu-jinga wa unjimu wakalaku, ukongelu wa jihundu.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Kikuma kyabetakota dingi kya ibanzelu yiyi kyene kiki: kwakala ngo utambwisu umoxi wayuka. Ubanza ngo ku itambwisu iyadi kala kyayuka mba kyatondala.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Kifwa kya kibanzelu kiki yadilungu ku mawujidilu amukwa mba ukalelu wa dimatekenu.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Athu ni ukexilu wa kifwa kikialani ubhanzelu wambote, asoku kubhaka mu kilunji mawukexilu, kubhatulula maka ni kukalakala mu mizambu ya ungijiye.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Athu ene dingi atundu m’uhete wa kutanga ibanzelu athu n’akwawu.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Kiki kyalombolola kmua twasoku kudyangela kmuona se kulweza ima yoso athu amukwa ejiya, andala, axikana, ejiya mba amesena.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Mu kaxi ka mawutenenu ya, owutetuluku wa wandalelu wa akwa kima kya katunda. Atwehele kusokesa ima kiyolombolole kyambote ibangelu ya nguzu.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Mu kifika, he wamwene muthu mubhula vidulu ya dikalu dimoxi, ngafika wejimutatela kunyana dikalu.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Hinu amufundisa mu kikexilu kyengi he watexisile jisabi ja dikalu anga yakexile dikalu dye mwene yakexile mufikisa kubula.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: RMN imatekena mu kidiwanu kimoneka kyexana kizuminu mbanza ya mawuta (RMN) ina yotukulule mu kwinyi dya mivu dya 1930 kwa Felix Bloch (mukalakadi wa xikola yamatala onene we ya Stanford) ni Edward Purcell (ya xikola ya matala onene ya Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Mu tumafuta tutu, okahonga ka wasu ni mafuta a mutelembe abangesa jatomo kwambata jimbimbi ja mutelembe.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Mu muvu wa 1970, Raymond Damadian, kimbanda ni ngijiye musoti, watonginina odimatekenu dya utelu wa izuzumbya mu konda dya ulondekesu wa ukexilu kuma utongininu wa kimbanda.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: K’ubhilu wa kiwana kya mivu abana patende imoxi, yakexile patenda yadyanga mu ngongo yabana mu utuminu wa RMN.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Mu muvu wa 1977, Dotolo Damadian wazuba kubanga kiselekete kyadyanga “mukutu woso” kilondekesa oyidyandu ya mukutu yenaxa “katena kumutolola”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Kudizwelesa kwakambe kibakanu kuhandamesa kithangana kya kuxingeneka ni kutambwisa kwa akwa.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Kibhana kumadilongi kutena kukalakala muwutenenu we ni kulonda wendelu wa jimbu yawulongelu.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Ha kima, kokwala dingi itateku yavulu yalungu ni kutena kwa kithangana kya ikalakalu yaleluka. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Utelu wa Internet ni ya World Wide Web yebhela maxibhulu kusanga jihundu mu ithanga yoso-yoso.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Maxibulu asoko we kutumikisa ibudisu kwa alongexi mu kithangana kyosokyoso kya kizuwa anga ukingila kitayelu ni lusolulwoso, phala kakinge kumutaya mu kyonge kyenge.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Owuzwelelu wa ubhe-wakayela wa kwijiya ulumbwisa ufolo wa mawunene. Seku kikexilu kyambote kyakwijiya.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Mu kidi, seku kima kyambote phala kudidongakyu. Okudilonga kusanga okibuta ku masunga mwaxaxe ka dixibhulu ni kwijiya kwalondekesa.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Omasunga metu mu izuwa ya lelu ni kayula koso “bhanga eye mwene” ni hundu yalondekesa, undonda ulondekesa ombandu yiyi mu mitelembe italesela kanga.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Mu dyetu twavulu twadisange mumona izuzumbya mu mutelembe utubhana ngolakela ya kilombolwelu kya kima kitwanda tena kubhanga.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Kitwanda bhanga dikalu dimoxi dya ubhe, kutunga fixi imoxi ku kithadi kyetu, kunyunga ku Peru phala kutonginina jingundu jokulu, mba kwidikisa inzo ya muzukame metu.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Tusakidila mikolu ya fibala otika akutila mu menya a kalunga, Eulopa ni jisatelite ja banda yasanzumuka, Groelandya ayinameka kyambote, ni 93% a athu ala ni Intelenet.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Kijima kye mba dixilu (he ukala mu inzo ya asonyi mba yakusobha) ngafika wakakala ni wifi mba PC yojikule ku Intelenete, anga jinzo joso jala ni jisyberkafwe mba kididi kimoxi kyala ni wifi ya mundu.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Kala kitwambe kutandu, ne omaka “Esquimo” jijila kuxikana kukala ni Estados Unidos, amba kuditobhesa ku mundu wavulu kana America ya thunda ya Artico, benge-benge ni Canadá.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Nyi kwila twasoku kwiva mbimbi yi akwa bhata dya Groenlandia azwela, uzwelelu we atokala aweha kwala akwa jixi jenge.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Atungi awuvwalukilu wa Gronelândia ayixana Inuit ku Canadá ni Kalaalleq (kivule Kalaallit), mukwa Gronelândia, ku Gronelândia.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Owufumbi, ni unguma kwa akwa jixi jenge joso, kitwene mukimona mu Gronelandya. Nyi mujimbanza, kanamu “ididi ya usweya.”
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Nangene okithangana kya mbambi kyene kitateku ngo kya kidi kyandamona kwala yo akambe kudiyidika.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: He eye ukunda ixi ya Groenlândia mwaxaxe ka ithangana yazayila (mu kutalesa kuma kyoso kyazukama dingi ku mbandu ya thunda, kwanda zayila dingi), kyabingi kwambata izwatu yavulu yatema.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Izuwa yalebha kyavulu mu itahngana ya mvula itena kubhekesa maka phala kuzeka ni maka alungu ni ukexilu wa sawidi.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Mu kithangana kyanvula, dimuka we ni jihamwe ja usuku ja thunda. Nyi kuma ki asambwisa uhaxi, atena kutema.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Nyi kwila umamenenu wa Sao Francico wakakala ni ufwamenu wa kukala kididi azungidi ya kitala kya ngongo yoso, wmamenu we wavulu ididi.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Mbandu y’onene ya ikalakalu yalungu ni ulangidilu wa athu abalakala, nguvulu, usumbisu ni uzungilu.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Ene mu mutajinga ku mimbu, jifilimi, jisabhu ja isoneku ni ifwa ni idifwa yokulu yene mu kwatekesa Mbanza ni ijikitu ye ayiji kya mu ngongo yoso.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: São Francisco wakudisa kikalakalu kyadikota ku mbandu ya ididi ya kukunda ni ijima yavulu, malumbu a kudila ni maxilu a kubanga kayula kabeta kuwaba.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: São Francisco kyene okididi kyabeta okuwaba kya ixi phala ojinzo jengi jakulamba ja Ásia: Mukwa Coreia, Mukwa Tailândia, Mukwa Índia ni Mukwa Japão.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Kwenda njila ya Walt Disney World kulomboloka njila yakatunda phala miji ya ixi ya América.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Ukundilu “watokala” ubhangesa kuphululuka ku Ditudilu dya jinjila ja utadi wa ixi ya Orlando, mu bhita kithangana kitena ku bhixila mu Sona imoxi se kutunda mu kididi kya Disney ni kuvutuka kubhata.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Ibilu-ibilu yavulu, maji phe athu oso ala kyeniki, kyalombwelela kmua kyoso azwela “kwenda ku Disne ni World”.
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Tumikanda twavulu twosumbise mu utalelu wa mundu bhu kaxi ka ididdi ya kusumbisa kala eBay mba Craigslist ene mukalakala ni tumikanda twa kunyoha ni dikalu mu izuwa yavulu.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Nyi kiki kikala kikalakalu kyaleluka, Disney kakixikina kana: mikanda katena kwisambukisa.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: O uzalelu woso-woso bhu kanga ku mbanjilu ya Grand Canyon wabingi utambwilu wa dibhengu dya ayo avu o mukau.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Dibhengu adixindi ngo mu kayula ka kulangidila mukwa kwenda ni adibhana mu kizuwa kya 1º ku mbeji, jimbeji jiwana kiluwa tubhixila mu mbeji ya dimatekenu.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Ididi phala misanzu yafumana dingi, kala Ditonokenu dya kuzeka Bright Angel yakala ku Rancho Fantasma, ene muyizalesa ku ibhingilu yatambula mu kithangana kyadyanga kyoso kyajikula ididi.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Kubokona mu África Astral ni dikalu kima kikola kumona uwabhelu wa mbandu ya ixi, kala we mubhixila bhu ididi kiyanyungi.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Yiyi asoku kuyibanga mu dikalu dyoso-dyoso ni usokeselu wambote, maji phe kota mu 4x4 ni mu ididi yavulu utena kwenda ni baze imoxi yala ni mukambu wa 4x4.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Ejiyakyu kuma mukufuna, ha mwene Mbandu ya Lwiji ya África ikale mukutululuka, mukwila jixi jenyoso jazukama kijatululuka.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Kadya ixi yakala ni ijla ye ajijidika kuma oyitumu ya lusolo atokala akala mu dikalu.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls yene mbanza imoxi ku mbandu ya fwila kumbi ya Zimbabué, ku mbandu yamukwa ku mbambe ni Livingstone, Zâmbia, anga yazukama ni Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Mu jimbeji ja mvula (Kamoxi ndu Katanu), mulundu wa menya wakavula anga ubalelu wa menya wakakala dingi ni kilwezu.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Mbila ya Tutankhamun (KV62) KV62 itena kukala mu kididi kyadyanga mu ufamenu wa jimbila ja Vale, bhu kididi kyotungunune kwala Howard Carter ku muvu wa 1922 ufundilu wa sobha ya munzangala.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Mu kilunga kyoso, mu kwisokelesa ni mbandu yadikota ya imbila ja enexi amukwa, mu mbila ya Tutankhamun koyatokala kwenda kwikunda, mukonda yatolo dingi ni ufwamesu wabutu.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Muthu woso-woso wandala kuya kutala dikwatu dyobhange ku kimbi mufikisa kumukatula mu kaxa adiwana, mukonda mutwe ni isixi yene ngo yamoneka.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: O wenji wakatunda wa mbila kowalemu dingi, awambata ku Inzo ya Misoso ya Egito mu mbanza ya Cairo.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Ajitu ni kthangana kyofele hinu kyabeta kota kubita kithangana kya mu kididi kyengi.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km ku ombe ya Siem Reap. Ngeleja yiyi yala bhulu dya mulundu yotunge ku sukilu ya hama ya mivu IX, mu kithangana kya uhungilu wa sobha Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Ukexilu wayibha wa ngeleja ni uyalelu ku mbandu ya kizanga Tonle Sap kibanda ku kamulundu kabetakota.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Owukundilu ku kididi kyasoku kukibanga kyambote ni wendelu mu ulungu ku kizanga.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Angkor Pass wabingi phala kubokona mu ngeleja, mukonda dya kyenyiki kana kuhukila kwambata mukanda we wa ngenji kyoso kiwenda ku Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jerusalem Mbonge ni yene mbanza yadikota ya ixi ya Israel, nyi kuma jixi javulu jamukwa ni akwa Naçoes Unidas kakitaya kwila yene Mbonge ya Israel.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Mbaza yokulu ku milundu ya Judeia yala ni sabhu yambote ayilongu um jihukaji ja mivu.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Kilombo kyakolo kya jingeleja jitatu jibheza ngo Nzambi imoxi – Judaísmo, Cristianismo ni Islão, kyadibhange we kaxi ka uxikanu, ngeleja ni ifwa ni idifwa.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Mukonda dya ulombolwelu wa kixikanu kya mbanza, mu kutalala ngo ku ididi yavulu ya ibhatu ya Mbanza Yakuka, Jerusalem kyene kididi kyabeta mu ixi ya Israel mutudila jingenji javulu.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerusalém ixi yakala ni ididi yavulu ya misoso, alukewolojiku ni ya ifwa ni idifwa, kala kididi kya usumbixilu, kafe ni jilexitawulande jihwima mu kuzala ni athu.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Equador wandala kuma akwa ixi ya Cuba adyanga kutambula mukanda wa wixanenu na bokona kiwa mu Equador mu kaxi ka dimanenu dya jinjila já utadi ja jixi joso mba mu ididi ya ubukwenu ku mbambelu.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Mukanda yu watokala awuxikanesa kwa Kidyandu kya mawenji wa jixi jengi kya Equador, ni kulanga ijila yamukwa.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Ijijidiku jiji ajibange phala kubana kivule kwa utundilu wa athu yokwidike mwaxaxe ka jixi.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Akwa ixi ya Cuba avu ditenda dya green card ya América ya Thunda abingi kukunda Sabalalu ya Ukunji wa ixi ya Equador mu kayula ka kutena kubokona kwa kima kiki kyabingi.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Kamukanda ka ungenji katokala kakala ni mwenyu kikale ngo mu mbeji ji 6 kyoso uxindilu wa izuwa ya kwenda njila. Kubhinga kamukanda ka kuya ni kakuvutuka phala kulondekesa ithangana ya ukexilu we.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Unyunginu ate dingi kitadi kyatolo phala ibuka yamakota, mu kiki, he wakala ubeka mba ni dikamba umoxi ngo, fikisa kwijiya athu engi ni kubanga phunga ya kiwana mba kisamanu phala nzongo yambote ku muthu.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Mu yoso, kiki kikitena kukala mu kidi bukanga dya kitenenu kye, mukonda mu itangana yavulu akwa kunyunga amwatanga makutu mu mbanjidilu phala kwizalesa makalu.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Yadimonekena kwila kikexilu dingi kya kubhunda athu, kwaxikinisa kuma atokala afuta dingi.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Bhuthandwalele dya sukilu ya thunda ya Machu Picchu kwala mulundu kiwayuka, wene mukaka mulele wa hota phala kuloza jifotu ja jingundu.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Kwoxa yala kala kikusilu kyofele, maji phe mulundu wa bengalala ni wabhonza, maji phe athu avhulu adisanze bhofele atokala atena kuwubanda mu ithangana yazukama ni 45.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Mabandelu ma matadi ene mujita mu kaxi ka njila, ni mu ididi ding jazenzama dingi omikolo ya utadi abana dikwatenenu dimoxi dya kuxilemena.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Mu kuzwela, ukinga kukala se nguzu ya kuzwela, anga waluka mu ididi yakondama, benge-benge kyoso kwabete, mukonda, ni lusolulwoso wasoku kukala ni kilwezu.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Kwala kadilundu kofele bhu mbanji ya thunda yi atokala kuzawuka, ya butu kyavulu anga yatolu lwavulu.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Kumona ididi ni mwenyu wa yangu wa Galapagos awubhanga kyambote mu ulungu, kala kyoso Charles Darwim wakibhange mu muvu wa 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Jibhita mu kitangu kya 60 mawulungu mamakota mabhita mu menya a Jigalalapago - jadixi mu ukomenu mu 8 mba 100 dya jingenji.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Athu avulu atuma kubaka okididi kya ni ithangana yadyangana (mukwila omawulungu amukwizala mu kithangana kya kileba).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Tongolola kuma mukalakadi mukonda dya mwene abhange kilungilu mwene ngijiye imoxi ya izanga ya Galápagos ni kwijiya kwa mbote kwa ndumba ni ndumba dya mawulungu.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Kiki kyakakwatekesa oyandalelu ye mba ibhidi ye ya ubeka yakasanga phala kuyizubha mu ulungu wala ni ukexilu wambote phala mwene.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Kiluwa kyabixila akwa ixi ya Espanha mu hama dya mivu XVI, mbandu ya thunda ya Chile yakexile mu utuminu wa Inca, kyoso akwa Arauca (Mapuche) atungile mwaxaxe ni ku mbandu ya lwiji ya Chile.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuche kibhuka kimoxi kyasukuku kya athu adyanga mu kuvwa kwa ixi America m’ufwolo, aminya oso kwala utuminu wa dizwi dya Espanha kyo ixi ya Chile yasange ufwolo.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Ne mbe Chile watambula diphanda mu 1810 (mu kaxi ka ita ya Napolão ita yabangesa Espanha kukamba utuminu wa jinguvulu mu mivu yavulu), Okutena kwasukuku akutambula ku maku a akwa Espanha mu muvu wa 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Oyixi Dominicana (Espanhol: Ixi Dominicana) yene ixi ya Jicaraíba ukwata mbandu Oriental ya kazanga ka Hispaniola, ukala kumoxi ni Haiti
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Ma kalunga kamuseke wazele ni muxitu wa milundu, ixi yene o inzu ya beta ukulu mbanza ya Europeia ya Americas, kindala mbandu ya Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Mu kizanga atungumu jinzo kya dyanga kwala Taínos ni Caribes. Caraíbas akexile mundu umoxi uzwela dizwi dya Arawakan abhixila mwaxaxe ka 10.000 a.C.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Mumivu yofele kyoso kabhixila atokwexi Europeus, mundu wa Tainos awusosolola lwavulu kwala atokwexi
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Mu uzwelelu wa Fray Bartolome de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) mu mivu ya 1492 ni 1498, misote ya Espanha ajibha 100.000 dya jitaino.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Kididi kya ithulu ya Kisangela. Kididi kiki akitungu ni dixilu dya dikota phala kididi kya jinganga nzambi mu sec. XVII, mu kaxi ke Ngeleja ya San Diego yene ngo osabhalalu yasubhuka.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Kindala kikalakala kala okitanda kya kaxi, kyene mu kala ni iphalamesu yavulu mu usuku.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Ijima sayi ku mbandu joso ja ididi ya jithulu, anga ku ngoloxi ni musuku ene musokesa izomba ya henda tunde ku mulundu wa kaxi.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Kanjila ka Nzobole). Jimbalanda jiyadi jadiwangununa mu 69 sentimetulu ngo yene inzo ya kuku imoxi ya muhatu musoso wa kizole.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Ni jisendavu jikuxi, anandenge akuxi andamutangela sabhu.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Kazanga Bowen kidi kya kunyunga mu kizuwa kimoxi mba mu sukilu ya sona yene mubhana kaulungu, wendelu wa bhoxi, maloja, ijima, ni ima yamukwa.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Kisangela kyadikota kiki kyalela ku Howe Sound, kwazukama ni Vancouver, kididi kikibonzu kubhixila mukaxi ka jitaxi jamenya jene mutunda ku kazanga ka Granville, mu kaxi ka Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Phala yo awabhela kukalakalela bhu kanga dyahatu, kwendela dikanga mu menya a Kalunga ku Dyulu kibeta kota kuwabha.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (mu kithangana kimoxi ni kaxaxe mu ulengelu wadikalu mu Vancouver) dikalu, yowijidile mukonda dya Yela ya Jixi mu kithangana kya kixibhu kya muvu wa midi jiyadi ni dikwinhi 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Mu kithangana kya mbambi, talesa jixikiyadolo amoxi abeta kota ya América ya Thunda, anga ku kithangana fikisa malunda a bixi a kidi ya mulundu.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Madibhengu abhingi kwabhaka dyanga. Kyabingi kukala ni dibhengu dimoxi phala kubhita usuku mu Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena kyene ngo kididi kya alangidi a matutu ene mubhana kidi kya kunyoha ni kudya kwateme se kuzwela ididi ya kubhanga jimanyi. La Leona, San Pedrillo, ni Los Pastos abana ngo kididi kya jimanyi ikalakalu ya kudya kana.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Tutena kutambula disesa dya kwimanesa makalu bu maku dya dimixi dya Kibela kya Ranger ku Puerto Jiménez, maji kene muxikina mikanda ya mazaku ma jimbongo
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Okikalakalu kya Jipalake (MINAE) kiyikatwisa madisesa ya jipaleke jakala ni mbeji imoxi mukudyanga yatokala ni ubixidilu yadyangesa.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: Café Net El Sol ilumbwisa kikalakalu kimoxi kya kujikita kididi mu swilu ya 30 a jidolale, 10 a jidolalemu tumikanda twa kizuwa kimoxi; ulombolwelu wambote sota mwibatu ya Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Ilhas Cook jibanga ixi ya kisangela ni Nova Zelandya, tuyisanga ku Polinesia, mukaxi ka musanzu wa Pacifico ya lwiji.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Kibhuka kimoxi kya tuzanda ni 15 dya izanga yomwangunune mu kibhatu kya jihulakaji ja Km2 kya musanzu wa kalunga.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Mu kwala muxinda wa ola wene umoxi ni ixi ya Havai, Izanga aene muyixana mu dijina dya “Havai ku lwiji kuna”.
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Ha mwene atolo dingi, ajumbuluka jikuku amoxi akwa kukunda kwa Havai, mu kithangana kyadyanga kyakukala unguvulu, se ijima yoso yamakota ni matenda ma mukwa.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Omazanga Cook kijakala ni jimbanza, maji akala ni 15 dya mazanga mengi. Abeta kota ene Rarotonga ni Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Mu izuwa ya lelu, mu jixi jakulu, owulumbwisu wa jihama ni kudya kwa kimene kwambote ene mu kubandesa kala mbandu ya ukexilu wa ikoji.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Ku sungu ya thunda, B&Bs amuzoka benge-benge mukonda dya kiyadi kya imbamba: izwatu ya hama ni kudya kwa kamene.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Mukiki, mu ididi ya mwabeta kota tutena kusanga kizwatu kya hama yawaba kyavulu, amoxi kivungulu kyatungu ni maku mba hama yokulu.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Okudya kwa kimene kwasoko kwiza ni utowaleluwa jisazona ya ibhatu mba malomga a kudya a utoko a mukwa ixi.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Kitelembe kitena kukala inzo ya malunda okulu ni ifwamesu yokulu ya inzo, kibhela kyolange kyambote ni pixina imoxi pixina.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Kubhokona mu dikalu dye anga wenda njila ya dikanga mu ikoka yala ni ulongesu yaswama mu ukexilu we .
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Kitubanze makalu amakota, ngafika kmua wala kya ni ndungi ya kwendesa dikalu dye, eye wejiya we bwoso bwasukila nguzu ye.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Kuphapha muyonga umoxi bhu kididi kyangene mba mu mbanza ya usanzumukinu woso-woso wasoku ni lusolo kutakana utaleselu kiwatokala.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Mu kusosa yoso, kwendela mu dikalu dye mu njila ya makanga phangu ya mbote anga kokinem’e “kuzeka bhu kanga mu mukau”.
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Tutena kuzeka bhu kanga dya inzo mu dikalu se kwakala minivan yadikota, SUV, Sedan mba Station Wagon ni yalu ibhana we phala kuzeka.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Ijima imoxi yatambula ijingu ya mivu ya wulu ya ikoka ya utadi ikalakala ni makala ni mawulungu azawuka Atlantico: Iya ya mundu ya kayadi kiyandekele luwa., mu seculo ya XIX mba mu dyandekelu dya século XX.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Ijima yakexile bhana bhukala itanga ni akwa fuma a kizuwa, ni mu ithangana yavulu akexile ni makudya makatunda ni mwenyu wa usuku.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Oyiselekete yakuka, okukamba utululukiluni ima yawubhe, ni ukukilu yabhangesa we mbandu ya kifwa kye.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Ha mwene kimbamba kyangene mu ubeka, sayi ithangana atambula ajitu atumini a unguvulu ni atumini amukwa.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Ngenji imoxi ni kiphuphu kya kitadi wasoku kujinguluka ngongo, mu wendele we wakaxikama mu ididi yavulu mu ijima.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Okayula kamoxi ka kudivutula owuzalelu kyene okisangela kibhana okaname kwa jingenji kwa atungi mu ilombo yenda mu kunda.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Kubokona mu wanda yu kwabingi kusoneka mukanda umoxi online; nyi kuma sayi mawanda abindamena kiyukisu mba utalesu wadibandekesa.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Isonekesu ya majina a atambwidi ala ni ididi akilumbwisa kyosoneke mu ditenda ni/mba online, sayi izuwa ni ulondekeselu ni izwelu ya jingenji jamukwa.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing adiyudika mu mbeji ya Katatu mu muvu wa 2004 kyoso ngijiye ya infolomatika Casey Fenton kyasange njila ya utadi mu swilu yofele phala kwenda ku ixi ya Islândia, anga mwakambele kibuta phala kuxikama.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Eye Mwene watumikisa e-mail ku maxibhulu ma xikola yonene yatokala kwenyoko anga watambula kitaangu kimoxi kyadikota kya ilumbwisu ya jinzo.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Ijima atambula benge-benge mizangala-mujitu umoxi wakala mu makwinyi ofele a mivu- maji we koko atena kusanga jinga anyungidi adyakimi.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Miji yakala ni anandenge kituyimono mu mesu azele, anga sayi ijima aaxikina mu maxilu ma ubheka.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Mbanza ya Pequim ku China yene yandakala mbanza yakutambula ajitu wa Malunda Olimpiku mu Kithanga kya Mbambi ni Mvula mu muvu wa 2022, yandamukexisa mbanza yadyanga mukubanga Malunda Olimpiku ya kithangana kya mvula ni kithangana kya mbambi ni mvula.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Mbanza ya Pequim yanda kwongeka ifwandu ya ujikwilu wa ni ujikilu ni ifwandu yabhange mu kibhela kya jelu.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Ifwandu yamukwa ya exiki anda kwibhitisa ku Taizicheng, em Zhangjiakou, mwaxaxe ka 220 km (140 jmilya) dya mbanza ya Pequim.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Jingeleja joso mu muvu akala ni kizomba kimoxi kimateka mu disukinu dya mbeji yadyanga ndu mukaxi ka mbeji ka kasambwadi, yene idilungulula kyatokala ni kalendalyu wa muvu ngeleja ni ngeleja.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Izomba yenyoso ya ngeleja ene mwibanga kala mbandu yakubanga mivu ya ngeleja mba mu ubangelu wa mivu unzambi mba ya kizomba kyoso-kyoso ya katunda yobunde ku ngeleja.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Izokoza ya Ngelejaya Kerala yambote kuyimona, ni wendelu wa kilunji ku mukalakata wa jinzamba jofamese, kibhuka kya jingimbidi já ngeleja ni izokoza yamukwa.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Kitanda kimoxi kya Ngongo ( yabeta kota mukuyijiya Utadiku wa Ngongo, mba Expo ngo) kyene kizomba kyadikota kya jixi jengi ya mawufunu ni kwijiya.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Jixi jabhange mbandu ku kayula ka kutadika kwa uhete ni ulongelu mu ibhela ya ixi phala kulondekesa maka atokala ku mundu ni musoso wa ixi ye.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Oyilondekesu ya Idima ya Honga ya Mundu yonge itunguka imonesa mixi, ibakala ya ithulu ni yoso dingi yatokala kuyisasa.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Sumbala mu ubanzelu ku muvu ni muvu itena ( he yasange mu ixi yengi), mu ubhangelu ki yene.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Izomba ya amukala mu jimbeji jitatu mba jisamanu, ene mujibanga mu ididi ni musanzu wofele ya 50 ekitale.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Kwala mawukexilu avulu ajifilimi kijadifwangana nj jitwene mumona mu mivu ni mivu. Pelikula itwejidila ya 35 mm (36 mu 24 mm negativo) yene twejidila dingi lwavulu.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Atena kuyita dingi se kitateku kyavulu mu kikexilu kyakuzuba, anga kibana usokesu kisokesa ni DSLR imoxi ya kindala.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Sayi jikamala jimoxi ja filime ja ukexilu wa kaxi wa 6 mu 6 cm kyatetuluka dingi mudituninu dya 56 mu 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Kiki kibhana kifundisu kyadikota mu luwana ni Negativu imoxi ya 35 mm (3136mm2 pholo ni pholo 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Mwenyu wa muxitu yakala mu kikuma kyakatunda phala mulozi umoxi wa jifoto anga kyabingi kibunjiku kya kuzediwa, mwanyu, masunga ni kisekete kyambote.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Okizuzumbya kya mwenyu wa mukawu, sayi izuwa yavulu awumona kuma watenena, maji phe kyene kimoxi ni jifoto joso.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Kifwa ya mwenyu wa muxitu ubhekesa mu itangana yoso kutonginina dikanga, mukonda ima yoso kala kibanga kya jinjila mbe mukolo wamesena kutonginina.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Yama yavulu jingenji ibhozo kwisanga, oyibhela yala mu jivez bengebenge yoso ukatula idifwa phala kusumbisa.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Yama yatena kukala ni jisonyi mba mukwa kubhala. Musanzu wa ngongo kitena kukala kya kutalala, yatema, mba kyanguma.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Ngongo yala mu kitangu kibhita mu 5.000 ja madimi madixi, tuwezako mu kitangu kibhita 50 ja jihukakaji mba lwavulu dingi dya azweledi.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Omabha asoneka abetakota dingi o kwatonginina se twasokesa ni mabha azwela we. Kiki kidi kyadiwanguna m’ukexilu wa jinjila, jabonzo kyavulu mu kwazwela kyambote phala kwayivisa.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Jixi javulu jakijimba azwela kyambote ingeleji, ni kwavulu we tukinga kukala ni wijidilu wofele – benge-benge kwa minzangala.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Banza, he wandala, Mukwa Mancunia, Mukwa Boston, Mukwa Jamaica ni mutungi wa Sidney waxikama ku nzalama mukudya mu kijima kimoxi kya Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Amudikenya mudya ni misoso ya jimbanza ja jawuvwalukilu, jozwele mu mazwi ma madifanganu mawuvwalukilu.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Kusumba kudya mu maloja kyene kibhangelu kya fika pala kudya kyambote. Ha kakubhana kijingu kya kulamba, oyisolelu, yatolu phala kukala ni kudya kwo lambe.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Ubhandelu wala mu izuwa omaloja amakota ala mu tambula mbandu imoxi ya kudya kwabi kya. Amoxi ene mu lumbwisa kadijiku exana micro-ondas mba ima yamukwa phala kutemesa kudya.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Sayi jixi jimoxi mba mawukexilu ma maloja kwakala ngo nangene kijima kimoxi ku kibuta, nangene izuwa yoso kijima kyakambe dibhengu ni swilu yaleluka.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Bhanga ni wa mbata oyifika ye ya ditona ni mikanda ya kisangela kya ulangidilu.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Atokala kulondekesa okididi kya intelenete ya kidyandu kifikidila anga ni jithangu ja mutelembe wa kudifetela ya jixi jengi phala ubanenu wa milongi /kubana kixikanu ni ulondekesu wa ikalanganzu.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Eye ukala ni kamukanda yamukwa ku imbamba ye ni online (e-mail phala eye ni ubandekesu, mba yobake ku “dituta”).
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Se wenda njila ni komputadolo kwa kwambata mba tabelete, ibhaka kifika mu kibhakelu mba dilola (dyajikula se Internet).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Bana we izuzumbya ya kamukanda ke kwa jingenji niakwenu, ku jindandu je mba makamba yana andala kukwatekesa.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Jingulungu (ejiya we kala hombo) kikene mu kubheta, adizokelela evwa kwakwatesa woma.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Kyoso athu akamba okumona okyama kuma kingulungumba kyakatunda, atena okudizukamesa kya vulu ni kudita mu kilwezu.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Nwa uholwa ni kulenduka. Uholwa utuwama ku mundu woso m’ukexilu wadiwanguna, kwijiya kwa mbambe ye ya unwinu kima kyakatunda.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Ikalakalu yakudisanza imoneka mu ithangana yavulu mukonda dya kunwa uholwa wavulu utena kumonekesa kimaji ni ufofo ni kufwa. Kilwezu kyabeta akibandekesa mukunwa uholwa kawubhangela muwutuminu.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Walende wabata wasoku kukala ni ufusa ujibisa kala metanoly, ibekesa uhaxi wa ufofo mba kufwa bofelebofele.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Mawana matena kuta kitadi kyofele mu ixi yengi, benge-benge mu jixi jala ni umvwama watolo mwala ikalakalu yofele.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Banza mukubhanga muzambu wa mesu ku bata, benge-benge kyoso kikwatekesu kikulangidila, ni ikubekela kamukanda ka milongu phala kuyibhaka mu kididi kyenge.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Mawuta akatunda akala bu ididi enyoyo atena kukala ni maka mayadi; amukwa atena kukala ikfikisu, anga omakidi yosumbe mu jixi jengi yate dingi kitadi kyanzungule kala yoyo ya ixi ya uvwalukilu.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kafwe yene dingi kibundu kyene musumbisa mu ngongo, anga yandatena kusanga idifwanganu yavulu mu kididi kye kya uvwalukilu.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Mu yoso, kwakala mawutelu avulu adiwanguna alungu ni kunwa kafe mu ngongo yoso asoko phala kufikisa.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Canyoning (mba: canyoneering) yalombolola kwila kwila, kwenda koxi ya mulombu, kikale kyakukuta mba wazala ni menya.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Canyoning kadifwamesa oyima uzowelu, uzongelu ni utukilu – anga kyabhingi kudisokejeka ngo lwofele m’ukexilu wa mukutu phala kumateka (kala kifika m’usokesu ni uzongelu mu matadi, mu kufimba mba kutonoka ni eski alpino).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Omawendelu yene ikalakalu bhulu dya kanga kibhangesa kwenda mu ididi ya yangu, mu ithangana yavulu mu jinjila phala mawendelu.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Kwenda kwa kizuwa kimoxi kwakala mu makanga ofene se twasokesa ni milya imoxi ndu mu makanga amakota atena kwenda mu kizuwa kimoxi ngo.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Phala wendelu kya kizuwa kimoxi kya leba kya njila kimoxi kiyatatesa kwa bingi mayidikilu mofele, anga muthu woso-woso watenena utena kutonoka.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Jindandu jala ni twana twandenge asoku kwandala usokesu wadikota, maji phe mu kizuwa kimoxi bhukanga twakisoku, nyi ni tubwetele mga twana twala mu kitala kya kuya ku xikola.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Mu ukexilu wangogo yoso, yala 200 dya yonge yangono yoso ni uzungilu mu kukalakala. Avulu akalakala mu ubheka.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Omubhingani wa Global Running Tours networks makwinyi asumbisi ya sightrunning mu ibuma iwana.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Ni jindanji ja Running ya Barcelona ni mu Running Copenhagen ya Copenhaga, mulusolo amumamika ku Running Tours Praga ni mbanza yala ku Praga ni yamukwa.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Kwakala imbamba yavulu yabingi kwila eye witongola kiluwa ni kyoso kiwenda ku kididi kyoso.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Kyoso kiwenda njila, kana kukinga kuma ima ikale kyoso kyala “kubhata dye”. Oyibhangelu, Ijila, makudya, ijima, ifwa, dimi, etc. yandakala, twafika, kiyadifwangana ni kididi bwoso bwalaya.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Kiki kima ki watokala kuta mu kilunji, phala kiwukale ni hunji mba kikotu mukonda dya ubhangelu wa ima kwa akwa ixi.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Omatenda a jinjila ja ungenji jale kya tunde mu sec.XIX. Ditenda dimoxi dya kunyunga yene mu yoso usolelu wambote wa kunyunga yenda mukaxi ka kwijiya kwadyanga kwa mukwa kunyunga kya, ifwa ni idifwam dizwi mba jixi jate kitadi kyatolo.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Ha mwene omatenda mavulu akala ni hanji yakuxikina omawubakelu mavulu, athu avulu abanga owufunu yatokala ya mawungenji, kakitangana kyatokala ni kitadi mba ixindilu.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Kyasoku kukala kima kyambote kuya ku musumbisi wene mu kubhakela kididi kya ungeji kyadifwangana ni kididi kya mwene.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Talesa jinjila ja ungenj ala mu sumbisa, kikale mu kididi (site) mba mu diloja.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Se wandala kumona ngongo mu swilu y’ofele, mukonda dya kumesena, ukexilu wa mwenyu mba kuzoka, kwakala kayula kukibhanga.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Mukwandeka, ajita mu matala mayadi: Mba ukalakala kyoso kyanyunga mba ufikisa kutununa oyisumbu ye. Kitumu kiki kyatokala mu yasukuku yiyi.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Phala yo akala ni hanji ya kutalesa hadi okukala kwe kwambote, okithangana kya kutulukisa.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Kyonge ixikana kwila ojingenji kanyana, kikabokona ni nguzu, kikala ku kitanda katitumina ku wenji, kikabhinga, he kabhuna athu amukwa mbe kubhanduluka kwe.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Kididi kimoxi kya ulangidilu wa ubokwelu ni utundilu wa athu kyene kya kwima dyanga mu kutuluka mu njila ya utadi, ulungu mba kyambetelu kyengi.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Mu jikumboyo jikuxi ja jimbambe, omawutokwesu ene mujibanga ku kumboyo mu kwenda watokala ukala ni mukanda wa kukwejiya kibhana mu kubhokona kwenyoko.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Mu jikumboyu kwa usuku, mikanda ma unyunginu atena kujibongolola kwala mwendexi phala kilu kakifudise.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Okisonekesu kibhangu kyadiweza phala omikanda ya kutena kukala ni muxinda wa kumona. Ku jixi jamukwa, watokala usoneka ukexilu we ni kididi bhwoso watungila ku atumini ya kididi.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Kiki kitena kujijisa usonekenu wa mukanda ni pudixa ya kididi kyenyokyo mba ukundilu umoxi ku dixilu dya jingenji.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Jixi javulu ala ni ijila kala yiyi, oyilamba yabhata akwata kusonekesa (kana kujimba kwibhula).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Mu kumona, kiki kibhangesa ijila ya utumu kukala mu uvundilu, kyeniki watokala ukivungununa.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Mutungi ubhinga kutunga sabhalalu. Utungilu wa kididi ni kutungajinga ubekesa jingenji mu kutena.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Jisabhalalu javulu jawaba kyavulu jakumona anga owumonekesu wa sabhalalu imoxi yaleba mba ya mbangula imoxi yate ni unjimu kitena kukala ukembu kyakuyala.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Adikitetula yaditundisa ku maufunu a mukwa, kumoxi ni ubanzelu wa kilombo, enjeyadiya sivile, ufunu wa kubhanga owutoko, designe ya moxi ni designe ya kitunda.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Mukwila athu avulu ya ukulukulu, kyandatena kusanga mwenyu wa usuku mu nzungule yawaba se kujeta phala Albuquerque mba Santa Fé.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Mu yoso, mbandu yonene ya jinzo ja mijoko yatange kuthunda amubhana kunwa, jinzo javulu we jamubhana ilayelaye ya katunda (benge-benge ya makota yendela ni lusolo ku mbanjilu ya jimbanza ja Albuquerque ni Santa Fé).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Aluka: Oyijima ya jimbanza jofele baba sayi izuwa kiyididi yambote phala asonyi a jixi jenge kutonoka.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Mu mbandu imoxi othunda ya Novo México yakala ni maka mavulu mukaxi ka yo akodiwa endesa omakalu, anga okidyongeku kya endexi ya makalu akodiwa yavulu mu mawuzukamenu ma jinzo jawuholwa ja jimbanza jofele.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Jimbale jakambe kumesena mba isoneku yofele ajijiya kala ngalafiti.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Nyi kwila yakala dikanga phaala kukala kimonekenu kya kindala, athu avulu akilungisa ni uzangelu wa kima kya mundu ni kya ngene kya minzangala kyoso asoneka ni mixinda ya xipalayi.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Mu kilunga kyoso, mu izuwa ya lelu, kwakala akwa ufunu wa kuxinda izuzumbya wabhange mu jimbalu “yayuka”. Ixindu ya izuzumbya mu kayula kaka yadifwangana lwavulu ni ikalakalu ya uhete bhu kibuta kya isoneku yakambe kutetuluka.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Utakwilu wa kitonokenu kyadifu ni ulungu ndunge yandala kwijiya o anyungi avulu.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: He wandala kudilonga kutakula kibumelu kimoxi kivutuka ku maku me, wakadyelela kuma wala ni kibumelu kyawabha phala kuvutuka.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Ombandu yadikota ya boomerans yakala ku ixi ya Australia, mu kidi, k’atena kuvutuka. Kyabingi okwila ayo akala bhu dimatekenu k’atena kufikisa kutakula ukexilu wa mvunda
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Kudya kumoxi kwa Hangi akulambela mu fixi imoxi yatema bhoxi.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Fixi ayitemesa ni matadi mateme ma dixita dya tubya, mba mu ididi yoso-yoso o munza wa kaxi dya ngongo kibangesa ididi ya bhoxi kukala ni utemenu.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Hangi ene muyizuwa yavulu muyidya mu ubangelu wa kudya kwa usuku kwa kwoha.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Ididi yavulu mu Rotorua abhana hangi geotérmico, kyoso hangi yamukwawu exikinisa mu Christchurch, Wellington ni mu ididi yengi.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail yakala ni jiphunga jiyadi jya jikomboyo mu Mbanza ya Cabo ni yazukama: MetroPlus (yexana we Ditala Dyadyanga) ni Metro (yexana Ditala dya Katatu).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: Metro Plus kyene kyawaba dingi anga kwakala athu atolo, maji yate kitadi kitadi kyavulu, ha hanji kyate kitadi kyofele mukuyosokesa ni mikanda woso-woso ya kumboyo ku ngongo ya Europa.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Kala kumboyo kwala o Metr oPlus kala maximbombo ya Metro; maximba Metro Plus jikala jinga ku sukilu dya comboyo bhwa beta kuzukama ni Mbanza ya Cabo.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Kyambetelu phala akamukwa – Kana kulanduka kwoso kwakexila jimala je, benge-benge kyoso kyukala mu kuzawuka jimbambe mubhita athu amutundila ku jixi javulu mu ngongo.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Anda tena okwita kuma njimbu ya ima ikola se kwijiya kwe mwene, mu kubhekes ibhidi yakatunda.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Kiki kyabundu okukinga mu munono, mu kiki ojimbwa jinuha makanya akola atena kwakalakalesa mu kithangana kyososo se kudyangesa ngolokela.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Sayi jixi jitalesa hadi kyavulu ha mwene mu ituxi yadyanga; ya atena kubokwesa mu kaleya nakalaku kwinyi dya mivu mba kutalesa hadi ya kufwa.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Jibela seku woso ujilangela, amujinyana natena we kwixana kilunji kya atumini, akala ni hele ya kuzeya kwa utakwilu wa jibujanganga.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Mu inzo, mukonda dya uditadikilu wavulu ku tubamba twa, ijimbwete yaleba dingi yakwila kiwandayikwata dingi.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Anga, ku jimbandu jengi mu ngongo, kwakala yama ya bakiteliyolojika ya ubhe phala eye, nangene kyasoko dingi kudisangaku ni maka.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Kikyene ngo, ku ididi ya teme lwavulu, ibamba ikula ni lusolu anga ilaya mu izuwa yavulu bhukanga dya mukutu.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Mu kiki, ojifalajelu ya Barriga ya Deli, Divuwa dya Faraó, o Vingasa ya Montezuma, ni makamba e avulu.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Kala kyalungu we ni maka a kubhwima mu ithangana yazayila dingi, maka a midya mu ithangana yatema mumoneka kitangu kyadikota kya itateku, anga koyikwatesa dikwatu dyakatunda.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: He uya ku ixi yakudisokololake onjila yadyanga ku mbandu ya ngongo yoso yoso kwambe okifwa kyawusokolwelu.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Jingenji javulu jakala anga atenena aabiti ku jihundu ja ubhe ja kunyunga ku ngongo mu ukudisu, mawusokesu mofele ma ifwa ni idifwa atena kudibandekesa ni lusolo.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Benge-benge mu izuwa ye ya kwandeka, banza uzubhilu wa kitadi mu ijima yadifangana ni ukexilu wa akwa fwila kumbi, ala ni makudya ni ikalakalu yikwatekesa mu unyohenu.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Kazeka bhu dikoloxa mba pheto bhoxi mu jixi jakambe kejiya yama.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: He wayi kuzeka, wiza ni hama imoxi ya kampijimu mba wanda imoxi phala kusetwisa ojinyoka, mazalala ni ima yalungu.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Zalesa inzo ye ni kafe kambote mu kimene ni xa ya kammula mu usuku.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Kyoso kyakala mu kithangana kya kunyoha, wakala ni kithangana kya kudisaka mwene ni kukatulaku ithangana phala kubhanga kima kyadiwanguna.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Ha wamudiva ubukumukinu lwavulu, andeka kya kithangana kyeniki phala kubhanga tumenya twa ibhundu mba utulungisa ni mayaki:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Amoxi utungununa kinwinu kya kingo itena kubanga ku kudya kwa kamene kyoso kyandavutuka mu ibangelu ye ya izuwa ni izuwa.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Se watungu mu kilombo ni kifwa kya kunwa uholwa wavulu, enda mu ijima mba pubs mu madyembu akambe kwenda.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Mwoso yo kejiya odizwi dya kimbanda, omaba atokala ni kutuwama anga ni kusambukila akala ilombolwelu yengi.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Uhaxi imoxi isambwisa yene yoyo ibangesa kukala ni uhaxi, kala tuyibamba tumoxi.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Uhaxi usambukila utena kudimwangununa ni lusolulwoso kyoso ukala bwazukama ni muthu wala ni uhaxi.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Jinguvulu ja vulu jabingi okwila asonyi abokona, mba o atungi atunda mu jixi ja ene abhana hanji o jivaxina jisaka o mauhaxi avulu o matelu.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Ikexilu ya sayi baba atena kukala ya jixi yakundu kwala mukwa kunyunga mba wamesena kukunda.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Kididi kimoxi kya sunga kya Charlote, Carolina ya Thunda, kyene kyala ni isolelu yavulu ya usunga wa dikota phala jindando.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Atungi a ibhatu yamukwa mu izuwa yavulu atona ukamba wa jindandu kwuila phangu yadikota phala kutena kwenda ku jixi ja, anga asonyi mu izuwa yavulu amona mbanza kuma yawabha kutonokamu ni ana ndenge bhu mbandu.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Mwaxaxe ka 20 dya mivu yabhiti, kitangu kya isangwilu yawabhela anandenge ku mbandu ya thunda ya mbanza ya Charlotte yene mu kukula ni lusolo lwoso.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Ojikandongelu, ku Charlotte, ojindandu kene mukwelaku, ha mwene wala ni valolo mu ithangana ikuxi.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Kwata kadijimu ka kuweza mukonda dya kuvudisa kiyadi kya jingenji, mu kidi phangu yiyi yabeta dingi mu swilu.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antártida kyene kididi kyatalala dingi kya Ngongo anga kyajingudisa Polo ya Lwiji.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Ukundilu wa azungi wakala ni swilu yakatunda, wabhindamena ukexilu wa mbote wa mukutu, atena ngo kubokona mu Ithangana ya mvula tunde mu mbeji ya Kamoxi ndu mu mbeji ya Kawana ni akala ngo mu kivule mu Ixi ya kibumu kyazukama ku musanza wa kalunga, Izanga ni Musanza wa Kalunga ka Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Hama ni jihama ja jihulakaji ja akalakadi alaya mu dimatekenu dya mvula mu makwinyi awana a miyonga, mu ididi iyi, atolo akolokota suke mu izuwa ya mbambi.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Antártida ya kaxi mulundu wofute ku 2 – 3 km kya matadi ma menya.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Owunyunginu wa kutuka wa jingijiye andaya mukaxi phala kubanda ku mulundu mba phala kubixila Kutandu, kyakala ni dixamenenu dyadikota.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Uzawukilua wa Mbandu ya Lwiji ya Ngongo (mba Rodovia) njila imoxi ya 1600 km kya kwimanena mu McMurdo, mu Musanza wa Kalunga wa Ross, ndu ku Sungu.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Mbundu yadikwatenena ni milombu yazala ni ayijikita ni mabandela. Mubhitila ngo mibabala ya utoko, ituta yambatelu ya phete ni kudya.
