text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Ene ya k’alenguka, mu kayula ka kubhana kikondoloke kyonene ku mbanjilu ya Milundu Transantárticas phala kubixila ku kidileke kya mavu.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Kikuma kyoso kibhekesa dingi ilwezu mu ithangana ya mbambi ikoka, miphasa (jikalasada) ni benge-benge we ididi ya kusambela yaxanana.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Mu kusosolola, watokala ukala ni jihayi jala ni idyotelu yambote. Ojihayi ja mbeji ya mvula jene muxalumuka mu matadi a menya ni mu mbundu, ni jihayi jamakota ja mbambi kijambote.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Kifika kyabingi kikala kyazongo kyambote, 5 mm (1/5 polegada) mba kisomboka, ni imbamba yasoko yafwama kyambote m’ukexilu wa zayila.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Kwala jihayi jamakota jala ni itomenu ni kwala izwatu yakuweza ni itomenu phala ididi yaxanana, yene yatokala phala jihayi javulu ni jihayi jamakota, phala tusende mba kitomenu ni kidyatelu.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Kutuka kwabingi kukala kwabutu ni kwasanzumuka. Mavu, tumatadi mba mongwa (cloreto de cálcio) akwamwanga mu ithangana yoso mu ikoka mba mu jinjila phala kuwabhesa kwa nguzu.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Oyisendumukinu twajijiya; omakungu abonza atena ngo kukwata matadi a mbundu atolu, kyoso avula isendumuka ni idibale.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Omaka yene okwila mbundu yene inamuka, yene yabingi umonenu phala kutuluka, ni mbundu mukutuluka kitena kukala kibitisu kyakutuluka phala kisubu.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Sayi ithangana, ifwandu ibatwisa ukexilu wa kidi mwanya mu kutemesa kwa, sayi ithangana mbundu dingi yofele, sayi ithangana ifwandu yamukwa ya yoso yatujingunu, lwavu muthu umoxi.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Ubhiluka mongongo ubhilujika wamulenge ubhusa kyofele, ukatula omulenge ubilujuka moxi phala kutandu.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Abanga itembwe ya nguzu (sayi itangana 100-200 ya jihulakaji/ola) anga atena kubalumuna ima yaneme bulu, mukwaambata kyoso okitembwe kyandalangu kidizambesa.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Amateka kala kinzunzilu mukudibala ku matuta ma kimvula, abhiluka “kitembwe kyadikota” kyoso kyabwa boxi.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Akwa kubhana mu henda ya kwa VPN (kibhuka kya umoxi kya izuzumbya) ene akwatekese a sunga mu kuzuba ufudisilu wa wanji ni kuswekesa ima ya kusumbisa ya IP.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Ene kota jipoloxye ja web ndenge mukonda dya ima yavulu: Mwakamumutumikisa ni ikalakalu yoso ya Intelenet, http ngó kana.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Abana mbandu yadyehelela kyavulu ni kikalakalu kyabeta kota. Ajijika anga, mu yoso, ki andatena kuzongola.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Omatenda a jihundu ene mututobesa mukwila phala “kufudisa miyi ya mimbu”.
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Mu kidi, ijimbwete ya ixi ki yala ni kibangu ku kizuzumbya kya makutu; kizuzumbya bit mu bit ya dilola dimoxi yandaxika mwene kyambote mu kiselekete kyoso kwoso kwaxikisa dilola dya kidi.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Kyandalu kya kidi kubana ku matenda kukondelele idima ya; kifa phe kujingulukisa kitadi.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Mukonda dya kwila oyixanenu ene muyitumikisa mu kaxi ka Intelenet, kikyatokala dingi kusota ikalakalu ya kisangela kya mitelembe kyakalela mu kididi mwoso watungila mba kwoso wandaya.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Kokyabingi we kukwata kitangu kimoxi kya dyembu mwatungu; atena kubhanga kixanu kimoxi mu Internet mukonda dya satelite mu mixitu ya Chicken, Alasca, ni kusangula kitangu kimoxi kilondekesa kuma wakala mu kididi kyatu mwanya ku Arizona.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Sayi izuwa, twatokala kusumba kitangu kimoxi kya ngongo kibangesa mitelembe ya kaswekele PSTN kukuxindila. Kwoso kwatundila okitangu ukatululuka phala athu anda kuxinda.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Ukexilu wa ulungulukilu wa isoneku mu ithangana yoxinde- ukexilu yo utena kulungulula ni lusolu izwelu yakavimba ya mikanda yamakota ya dimi dimoxi phala dyenge.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Sayi ibangu ya kitala kiki atena mwene kubilula mikanda mu mazwi ma jixi jengi kutandu dya ijimbwete mba ima yengi mu ngongo ya kidi, kyoso omukwa kubanga ulondekesa smaletephone phala oyima yiyi.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Jimotolo ja kulungulula jimbimbi jayuka kyavulu ni lusolu lwoso, mu kindala mu izuwa yavula itubhana ilunguluku yambote (algalavia ki yene mu moneka), maji phe kibhinga kudilanga kyavulu, mukonda haji asoku kuthethuluka kyayibha.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Kikalakalu kimoxi kyabeta mu ikalakalu yamukwa Google Translate, ilungulula jimbibi offline kyoso ubhanga download ya izwelu ya mazwi yandala.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Okukalakala ni idyandu ya kusotasota GPS mu smaletefone yasoku kukala kikalakalu kya bebuluka ni kyatokala kusotasota kyoso dikanga dya ixi ye ya uvalukilu.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Wasoku kumamena kitadi kyoso usumba jimapa phala GPS imoxi, mba usumbilu wa kiselekete kya tokala ku GPS ya ubeka mba mu usobeselu wa kima kimoxi mu jinzo ja makalu jene musobesa.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: He kiwala ni jidadu jojikule phala mutelembe we wa kaswekele, mba kyoso ukala dikanga dya kinameku, okikalakalu kye kyasoku kwimana mba kidijika.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Diloja ni diloja mu ikoka dyazala ibhuka ya tumikanda twa mitelembe ya kaswekele ya kudyanga kufuta, tumikanda tutu twasoku kutuphopheka phala mitelembe ya mundu mba mutelembe woso woso.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Nyi kuma mbandu yadikota ya mikanda yambote phala kuxinda ku kididi kyoso-kyoso, amoxi adilongo ufunu wa wa kubhana swilu ya kixanu yawebhela ku ibhuka ya jixi jimoxi.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Kwijiya ikalakalu yiyi sayi ithanganaya ayivwila mu kaxi kamitelembe yahenda ngo mba we kixanu kitunda mumitelembe kiyofute.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Oyijila yatokala ni mwene foto ajitá we ku nglavasawu ya video, ayibanga hanji dingi.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: He ukatula kizuzumbya kya kima kyoso-kyoso kikyatokala, kyenyiki kiwatokala ni ngo kubhanza kumubhakesa mu vidyu.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Se utaku dolone imoxi, talesa dyanga ihi yaka mu dibhengu dya kufilimala ni kuxikina mba dibhengu dyabingi kubandekesaku.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Kuphululuka ni dolone bhu mbanji ya ikoka ya jinjila ja utadi mba bhutandu dya mundu wavulu ki ndungi yambote kana, ne kya se kijila kwoso mwatungila.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Mu izuwa lelu kunyunga mu iphululu kyabonso abakela kididi mu matenda endesa iphululu yenyoyo he asumba mukanda.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Sayi izuwa, kiphululu kyene kimoxi kyasoku kukala ni swilu jadixi kyavulu mu ididi yavulu anga, kotelele kusumba tumikanda twa kusota anga udyangela kutalela we mu ididi ya intelenet ya kisangela kya jinjila ja utadi ni ubhakesa kiwa okididi.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Nyi kuma kiwandala kutambula kamukanda phala kwenda njila mu jixi jenge mubhita tuyizuwa kala muukwa kunyunga mba phala kwenda ku wenji, mba mudilonga wa jixi jenge, kyene mubhika ukexilu wa izuwa yavulu, abanga izuwa yatolu yana aya ngo mu nyunga.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Mu yoso, okukala mu ixi ya dikanga mu kithangana kyavulu kyandajijidika kamukanda ka ulondekesu.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Oyixindilu ya ungenji wa maxibhulu yene mukala ni ukexilu ni ilondekesu yenge mu ikalakalu yenge kiyadifwangana ni ixindilu ya ungenji yoso-yoso ya akwa kuzunga mba akwa wenji.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Ku jixi javulu jamukwa, kwanda bhinga mukanda umoxi wa kulumbwisa wa ditenda kwoso wandala kuya mu dilonga, wakakala we ni kitadi phala kutena kulaya nyi ngo mu muvu wadyanga ya dilongelu dye.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Tala ni mbonge, kala we ni kibhatu kya ubokwenu mu ixi mwoso wandala kudilongela phala ukale ni ima yoso yi watokala.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: He ukala umukunji kana, mukonda kukalakala ku jixi jengi kyalombolola kwila wakazwela dijimu kuthandu ya ifutilu ya ikalakalu ye mu ixi mu watungila.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Dijimu yatokala ku ngasu yakala mu ukexilu wadixisa mu jixi jadixisa we, futu ni ditala dya usokejeku wa madijimu ubhiluluka mu ukexilu wa ixi ni ixi yengi.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Ku jixi jamukwa jala ni utumu wa kisangela, kala Estados Unidos ni Canada, difutilu dya dijimu adibhinga mu ididi ya diwangununa, kyenyiki musanzu ni musanzu wala ni swilu ye ya dijimu.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Ha okikondelu kyakutunda moxi dya ixi kiyatumbuluka mu mesu makumona mba kifwa kyakukala kyoso kyabixila ku ixi ye, okikondelu kya lufandeka itena kukala kya dilamba.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Dixikinise he wejiya yoso utena ni yoso kiwutena kwambata ni kuzwela ima yoso-yoso kiwatokala kuzwela kima kyoso-kyoso mu usanzumunu wa isukinu yayuka.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Ukexilu waleluka dingi wakumateka mu wenji wa kusoneka kwa kunyunga kyene kuyukisa mawutenenu ma mu kididi kimoxi web ya blog ya kunyunga yate.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Kyoso kyadivu kyambote mukonda dya uyukisilu ni usokejeku mu web, ku ngoloxi dingi, wanda bhanga owebsite ye mwene.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Kudibhakula ku wendelu wa njila kibanzelu kya mbote kyadiwanguna, kokwilaku ngo kudibhakula.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Kulaya ni kukala mukwatekese mu ixi yenge ukexilu wambote phala kutena kwijiya ifwa ni idifwa ya jixi jenge, kwijiya athu enge, kudijiya we, kukala ni ukexilu wa njila mu kusuka wakakala ni ndungi jawubhi.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Kikituluka we phangu yambote ya kusanzumuna kitangu kimoxi kya jimbongo phala kwebhela kukala mu kithananga kyalebha, mukonda ikalakalu kudibhakula ibhekesa kibuta, udikilu ni amoxi abhana futu imoxi y’ofele.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Vikings endela mu jinjila jy jihonga ja Russa phala kubhixila ku Mar Negro ni ku Mar Cáspio. Jimbandu ja jinla jiji ajendela hanji. Muyala ubhelu wa kwandala disesa dya lumbongo lwa kwenda, dyene dibhonza kudibhana.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: OMukungulukilu Mar Branco-Baltico unameka oKalunga ka Arctico ku Kalunga Baltico, mukonda dya Kizanga kya Ladoga ni São Petersburgo, mu mbandu y’onene ya jingiji ni izanga.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: O kizanga kya Onega we kyaditakanesa we ni Volga, mu kiki, kutundila ku Kalunga Cáspio mu njila ya Rússia yasoko hanji.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Walungu kwila kyoso kyandabhixila ulungu yoso yandawabhe. Kyandadisanga ni akwa amubhingila boleia mu ulungu njimbu ya andaditambwisa onjimbu ni ene we.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: M’ukexilu waleluka, eye wanda xisa ngolokela mu kubhana dikwatekesu, mu kwendela mu doka, mu dizukamesa kwa athu abhanga ikalakalu ya kukomba maulungu me, mu kufikisa kubhangesa kudivwa ni madinyelu mu kijima ni yamukwawu, etc.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Fikisa kuzwela ni kitangu kyadikota kya athu uwatena kusanga. K’ubhitilu wa kithangana kimoxi athu oso anda kumwijiya ni anda kumubhana masunga alungu ni ulungu webhi wamusota muthu umoxi.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Watokala usola kyambote kibhuka kya jinjila ja utadi jiwendela izuwa izuwa.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Nyi kuma wakatena kubhanza kuma kyakubanza okutena kukala kumoxi ni kisangela kya jinjila jawutadi jiphululuka dingi, watokala ukijiya kuma owuzediwe wolumbwise wene mu dixa anga ididi ya jingenji jene kya mwenda lwavulu asoku kukala ni henda mu kaxi ka kisangela kya jinjila ja utadi kijadifwangana mu kisangela kimoxi.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Isangela ya jinjila ja bhulu kala Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airwais ni Turkish Airlines aweza ikalakalu ya ndu mu Africa mba alumbwisa jinjila jaditela mu jimbanza jenge ja Africa mu jiswilu jatolu mu uzongelu ni isangela yamukwa ya Europa.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Okisangela kya jinjila jya utadi ku ixi ya Turkia kyendela ku 39 dya ididi mu 30 a jixi jya ngongo ya Afidika tunde mu muvu wa 2014.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Se wakala ni kithangana kyadibandekesa phala kwenda njila, talesa kyebhi swilu yoso ya kwenda ku ngngo ya Afidika ni wisokelesa ni swilu imoxi ya kuzungila mu ngongo.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Kana kuhukula kubandekesa ku ngasu ya kisubhuke ya dibhengu ya kisubuke, swilu ya utundilu, yambetelu ya bhoxi ni yamukwa ku ididi yoso bukanga dya ngongo ya Afidika.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Se wamesena kutukila mwaxaxe ka Mbandu ya Lwiji ya Ngongo, usangwilu wa jinjila ja utadi ni kididi kya kwenda akute mbambe mukonda dya ukambu wa kwijiya kwa njila ya musanza wa kalunga ndu ku Oseyaniya.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Kanaku kisangela kya ungenji bhulu kitena kusokela ni kuditela mu jinjila ja kalunga mu lutatu ku Hemisferio ya Lwiji (ni Sky Team katema kutena njila iyi).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Kiki, o Star Alliance ivunga yoso, katuku o Pacífico Sul Oriental, ya Santiago ya Chile ndu Taiti, kubhita onjila ya utadi kya LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Kiphululu kiki kikyene ngo kitena he wandala kulenga Pacifico ya Lwiji ni mbanji ya fwila kumbi ya America ya Lwiji. (kutala ku lwiji)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Ku 1994, ku kididi kya Arménia kya Nagorno-Karabakh kwa Arzebaijão wimanesa ita ni akwa azeris.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Ni kikwatekesu kya Armenio, abange ixi imoxi. Mu kusuka, kanaku mbanza yadifikidila – nyi Armenia – kayijiya ku pholo ya mundu.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Uzwelelu wa ukunji ku mbandu ya ixi yasuluka ni kuzanga ukexilu wa ukamba bhukaxi ka Armenia ni Azerbajão.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Mbanza ya suku (wa Holanda Grachtengordel) yene ya fumana Mbanza ya hama XVII ikondoloka Binnenstad Binnenstad ya Amesterdão.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Kibhatu kyoso akixinde kala Kdidi kya Ngongo ku mbandu ya UNESCO mukonda dya swilu ya ifwa ni idifwa ni mu jisabhu ja ubheka, tuwezaku jiswilu ja ididi yala mu kitala kyonene.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, yalombolola Jixi Jitanu, ilondekesa ibhatu itanu ya madyembu akexila ku mbandu ya Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza ni Monterosso yakexila ku ididi ya Italia ya Ligúria.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Adisonekesa mu Mukanda wa undundu ya Ngongo ya UNESCO.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Ku ubhitilu wa ndumba ni ndumba dya mivu, athu ene kutunga ni uhete woso ku thandu dya jisabalalu mu ibhela yakala ni itateku ni ibhidi ndu ku umwenu wa musanza wa kalunga.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Mbandu yakuwaba kwe kwene owukambelu wa ukudisu wa matenda yomonekese. Jinjila, jikumboyo ni maulungu adilunga ni madyembu, anga omakalu katena kubixila kwa ene tunde kukanga.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: O idifwa ya frances yene muzwela ku Beljika ni ku Suiça ne mbe yadixi bofele ni françes ya França, maji phe mudya aditakanesa mu diva.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Mu kaswekele, ukexilu wa kuta itangu ku Bélgica Francófona ni ku Suíça yakala ni ukexilu wofele wadiwanguna ku Francês yamuzwela mu ixi ya França, ni uzwelelu wa mabha amoxi adixi lwofele.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Mu kilunga kyoso, akwa ixi yoso ya Bélgica ni Suíça azwela dizwi dya Francês endele kudilonga Francês ya kidi mu xikola, phala kutena kuditetuluka nyi mwene mutelu wa kayula ka itangu yaxindi mu ijila ya kuzela kwa dizwi dya Francês.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Ku jixi javulu jamukwa, kubhalula ukexilu wayuka wawukamba, ulondekesa “kumenekena.”
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Mukuzuba, ku Malasia, mukaxi ka akwa Malasia ala mu jisanzala, kyalombolola “kwiza”, kyadifwangana ni mulembu wa kulondekesa mu ulondekesu wa mukutu, kibhangelu kya athu avulu mu jixi jya Fwila kumbi, anga kyatokala akibhanga ngo phala ukexilu yu.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Kyene kimoxi, ngenji imoxi ya Britania ku Espanha yasoku kujimba kuxalesa ni likwaku lwolunguluke kwa muthu wamulekela (hinu wakibhange kwa muthu uwamulekela) kala kilondekesu kya uvutukilu.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Omazwi mawukwatekexi mazwi ma makutu mba jotunge ni kibanzelu kya kukwatekesa owuzwelelu mukaxi ka mundu mu kikexilu kya kwila se kyengi hinu seku kudizwela.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Adiwangununa ku mazwi makidi, kuma mazwi mahatu mba idyandu ikituluka ituminu mukonda dya kikuma kimoxi mba kuma kima kya kuditambwisa bhu kaxi ka azwidi a mazwi amukwa.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Mu munza wa kizuwa, akwa kunyunga atena kufikisa kumona kwa izala ya menya (mba ima yengi).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Yiyi yasoku kukala ni usweya he ngeji ukayela ubenya wa mukawu, mukuzanga nguzu yambote ni menya akisubhu.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Nyi mwene mukawu watundu dingi mu kutema utena kuzayila kyavulu m’usuku. Hipotelemiya kitateku kya kidi m’ukammbu wa izwatu yatema.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Mu mbeji ya mvula, benge benge, kala waluka ni jihamu, kyoso wandala kubhita mu ditutu dyateme.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Katuku ukexilu wa kwendesa mukonda dya muxitu watema ni wa kaxi, twithangana twofele ni mabitu ojikule kyoso kyabokona mu kyambetelu kithangana kyasoko phala ubokwelu wa jihamwe mu kyabetelu ni mwene.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Okixinda kya jinjila, mba ayijiya dingi kala infuluwenza kya jinjila, utena kusambwisa jinjila ni ibhaku amwa.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Kikyatena kazunda ka ilwezu ku athu, maji phe amoxi kala kyambote.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Ombandu yonene ya athu amukalakala ni usaselu wa jinjila, kwakala we kibinda kwa atalexi a jinjila.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Ilondekesu ku Noroega makungu ni milombu yabengalala ikubhixidisa ku mulundu, wabase kyambote.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Kidileke kya mavu ene mujizwela jinga kala “vidde” kyajimbuluka kididi kimoxi kyadikota anga kyajikuka kyakambe mixi, musanzu yakambe jimbambe.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Mu Rogaland ni Agder aexana “hei”, kilomboloka omu kizakazaka kya malowa kwakambe o mixi kyavungu kwala owurze.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Jigalasiyale kojakondama kana, anga jilangumuka mu mulundu ndu bhoxi. Kiki kyanda bhekesa mamwelu, jikelevase, jatena kuxikelesa kwala milonde ya mbundu.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Jimbalu ni kizambelu kya malundu ma matadi ma menya andatena kubwa anga omisula andatena kudijika.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Kibumu kya matadi a menya mbandu yamakota adiwangununa, abwa amoxi atuka mba ajinguluka mu kididi kyadisanduka ku kibumu.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Oyitangana ya akwa ungenji phala oyitangana ya milundu yene mu bhxila suke kuthandu mu izwa ya mvula ku Indya.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Mu kiki, kwala ukexilu wengi wa kuwabha ni kuyuka mum kithangana kya mbambi, ni ithangana yavulu ya muludu itambula kudisanza kwa mbundu yanzungule ibhana ikalakalu kala ya esqui ni ya snowboarding.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Isangela imoxi ngo ya jinjila ja utadi hanji alumbwisa kifutilu kya thambi, kyene kisosolola bwofele swilu ya ungenji wa jithambi ya kithangana kyasukuku.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Matenda a jinjila ja utadi akwibana ene kala Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa phala jinjila ja utadi jatundu ku ixi ya EUA mba ku ixi ya Canadá ni WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Mu mawukixilu moso, kyabingi kubhanga kilundilu mukonda dya mutelembe wa kudifetela ni ditenda dya jinjila ja utadi.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
